Create `test/unit/floatingIslands.test.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * floating_islands' islands term on real columns (SP3e spec §3.1-§3.5, D3, D4, D5), seed 42, the mask on:
 * - §3.2's arguments: the ungated BODY = 20·(NI − 0.9 − 3·q + 4·(m − 1)) is ≤ 0 at every corner outside 200 … 256 (so
 *   the window [192, 265) cuts nothing) and at every corner whose m < 0.25 (so the cluster gate cuts nothing);
 * - every island voxel (solid with the tree, air with the islands tap muted) lies in y 193-263, above
 *   `ISLAND_RUN_MIN_BOTTOM`;
 * - compiled == reference and probe == bulk on island columns (m = 1, and 0.25 < m < 1), voxels and corners of the band;
 * - water v0 under islands over the sea (D5 on real data): the column's fluid equals the muted column's, and the
 *   heightmaps equal a top-down scan (the island top + 1 at island positions).
 * The columns are `terrain.real` bench candidates (tc ≤ 216) found by scans; the tests re-derive what they rely on.
 */
import { describe, expect, test } from 'vitest';
import { ISLAND_RUN_MIN_BOTTOM } from '../../src/core/constants';
import { fnv1a32 } from '../../src/core/hash';
import type { JsonValue } from '../../src/core/params/json';
import { FLOATING_DENSITY_TREE } from '../../src/core/params/presetTrees';
import { resolveProfile } from '../../src/core/params/profiles';
import { Xoshiro128 } from '../../src/core/rng';
import { seedFromInput } from '../../src/core/seed';
import { newPointRecord, samplePoint } from '../../src/gen/column/columnPoint';
import { createGenContext, type GenContext } from '../../src/gen/context';
import { cornerValueIndex } from '../../src/gen/density/compile';
import { createDensityContext } from '../../src/gen/density/context';
import type { Expr } from '../../src/gen/density/expr';
import { probe } from '../../src/gen/density/probe';
import { createDensityReference, interpolatedNodes } from '../../src/gen/density/reference';
import { terrainDensityDebug } from '../../src/gen/pipeline/terrainStage';
import { fillColumnT } from '../../src/metrics/region';
import { AIR } from '../../src/world/blocks/index';
import type { ColumnView } from '../../src/world/store/api';
import { createStore, type VoxelStore } from '../../src/world/store/store';
import { paramsWith } from '../harness/gen';
import { topDownHeightmaps } from '../harness/heightmaps';

type Col = readonly [cx: number, cz: number];
/** m = 1 at all 49 lattice points, offset0 < 63 at the centre: an island over the sea (tc 82). */
const SEA_CORE: Col = [19358, -22222];
/** 0.25 < m < 1 at all 49 lattice points, offset0 < 63 at the centre: a cluster edge over the sea (tc 148). */
const SEA_EDGE: Col = [2012, -10108];
/** 0.25 < m < 1, land: a large island (tc 216). */
const LAND_EDGE: Col = [504, -28536];
/** Lattices that straddle the cluster gate (min m < 0.25 ≤ max m; tc 65, 70, 206). */
const GATE: readonly Col[] = [[4735, -2615], [-15670, -18970], [-18686, 4174]];
const ISLAND_COLUMNS: readonly Col[] = [SEA_CORE, SEA_EDGE, LAND_EDGE];

const FLOATING = resolveProfile('floating_islands');
const ctx: GenContext = createGenContext(seedFromInput('42'), FLOATING);
/** The same world with the islands tap muted (−1e6 under `max`: the default ground, the mask and the flag still on). */
const mutedTree = (): JsonValue => {
  const t = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(FLOATING_DENSITY_TREE)) as { root: { b: Record<string, unknown> } };
  t.root.b['mute'] = -1000000;
  return t as unknown as JsonValue;
};
const muted: GenContext = createGenContext(seedFromInput('42'), paramsWith({ islands: { enabled: true }, density: { defs: mutedTree() } }));

const dc = createDensityContext(ctx);
const ref = createDensityReference(dc.expr, dc.noises);
/** The resolved tree's nodes of §3.1: interpolated(rangeChoice(m, rangeChoice(y, BODY, −1e6), −1e6)). */
const term = (dc.expr.root as unknown as { b: { x: { x: { x: Expr; inside: { inside: Expr } } } } }).b.x.x;
const M_NODE = term.x;
const BODY = term.inside.inside;

const newStore = (): VoxelStore => createStore({ shared: false, maxBlockBytes: 8 << 20, maxByteBytes: 8 << 20 });
const generate = (c: GenContext, store: VoxelStore, [cx, cz]: Col): ColumnView => {
  expect(fillColumnT(store, c, cx, cz, () => false)).toBe(true);
  return store.proto(cx, cz)!;
};
const centre = (c: GenContext, [cx, cz]: Col) => {
  const p = samplePoint(c, 16 * cx + 8, 16 * cz + 8, false, newPointRecord());
  return { m: p.islandMask, offset0: p.offset0 };
};
/** islandMask at the 5 × 5 corner columns of a column, as the tree reads it (`col islandMask` inside `interpolated`). */
const cornerMasks = ([cx, cz]: Col): number[] => {
  const s = dc.column(cx, cz);
  const out: number[] = [];
  for (let j = 0; j <= 4; j++) for (let i = 0; i <= 4; i++) out.push(ref.corner(s, M_NODE, i, 0, j));
  return out;
};

describe('the fixtures (SP3e spec §3.1, seed 42)', () => {
  test('the island columns hold island voxels; the sea ones lie over the sea; the gate columns straddle m = 0.25', () => {
    const sea = centre(ctx, SEA_CORE), edge = centre(ctx, SEA_EDGE), land = centre(ctx, LAND_EDGE);
    expect(cornerMasks(SEA_CORE).every((m) => m === 1)).toBe(true);
    expect(sea.offset0).toBeLessThan(63);
    for (const c of [SEA_EDGE, LAND_EDGE]) expect(cornerMasks(c).every((m) => m > 0.25 && m < 1), `${c}`).toBe(true);
    expect(edge.offset0).toBeLessThan(63);
    expect(land.offset0).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(63);
    for (const c of GATE) {
      const m = cornerMasks(c);
      expect(Math.min(...m) < 0.25 && Math.max(...m) >= 0.25, `${c}`).toBe(true);
    }
  });
});

describe('§3.2: the window and the cluster gate cut nothing (the ungated BODY at every corner)', () => {
  test('BODY ≤ 0 at every corner y ≤ 192 or ≥ 264, and at every corner with m < 0.25; positive corners exist inside', () => {
    let positive = 0, lowMask = 0, outside = 0;
    let maxInside = -Infinity;
    for (const c of [...ISLAND_COLUMNS, ...GATE]) {
      const s = dc.column(c[0], c[1]);
      for (let k = 0; k <= 48; k++) {
        const y = -64 + 8 * k;
        for (let j = 0; j <= 4; j++) {
          for (let i = 0; i <= 4; i++) {
            const body = ref.corner(s, BODY, i, k, j);
            const m = ref.corner(s, M_NODE, i, k, j);
            expect(Number.isFinite(body), `${c} corner (${i}, ${k}, ${j})`).toBe(true);
            if (y <= 192 || y >= 264) {
              outside++;
              expect(body, `${c} corner (${i}, y ${y}, ${j}) m ${m}`).toBeLessThanOrEqual(0);
            } else if (m >= 0.25) maxInside = Math.max(maxInside, body);
            if (m < 0.25) {
              lowMask++;
              expect(body, `${c} corner (${i}, y ${y}, ${j}) m ${m}`).toBeLessThanOrEqual(0);
            }
            if (body > 0) {
              positive++;
              expect(y >= 200 && y <= 256 && m > 0.475, `${c} corner (${i}, y ${y}, ${j}) m ${m}`).toBe(true);
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
    expect(outside).toBe(6 * 25 * 41);
    expect(lowMask).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(positive).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(maxInside).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  });
});

describe('island voxels and water v0 under islands (SP3e spec §3.2, §3.5, D5)', () => {
  const store = newStore();
  const mstore = newStore();

  test.each(ISLAND_COLUMNS.map((c) => [`${c[0]}, ${c[1]}`, c] as const))(
    '(%s): island voxels in y 193-263; the fluid equals the muted column\'s; heightmaps = the top-down scan',
    (_name, col) => {
      const v = generate(ctx, store, col);
      const mv = generate(muted, mstore, col);
      const aux = v.aux()!;
      let island = 0, lo = Infinity, hi = -Infinity, islandPositions = 0, wetUnder = 0;
      for (let p = 0; p < 256; p++) {
        const lx = p & 15, lz = p >> 4;
        let top = -65, islandTop = -65;
        for (let y = -64; y <= 319; y++) {
          const solid = v.block(lx, y, lz) !== AIR, mSolid = mv.block(lx, y, lz) !== AIR;
          // max(terrain + detail, islands): the islands term only adds solid voxels.
          if (mSolid) expect(solid, `(${lx}, ${y}, ${lz})`).toBe(true);
          if (solid && !mSolid) { island++; lo = Math.min(lo, y); hi = Math.max(hi, y); islandTop = y; }
          if (solid) top = y;
          expect(v.fluid(lx, y, lz), `fluid (${lx}, ${y}, ${lz})`).toBe(mv.fluid(lx, y, lz));
        }
        const hm = topDownHeightmaps(v, lx, lz);
        expect([aux.worldSurfaceWG[p], aux.oceanFloorWG[p]], `(${lx}, ${lz})`).toEqual(hm);
        if (islandTop > -65) {
          islandPositions++;
          // The island is the highest solid run, so both heightmaps are its top + 1.
          expect(hm, `(${lx}, ${lz})`).toEqual([top + 1, top + 1]);
          expect(top).toBe(islandTop);
          for (let y = 0; y < ISLAND_RUN_MIN_BOTTOM; y++) if (v.fluid(lx, y, lz) !== 0) { wetUnder++; break; }
        }
      }
      store.freeColumn(col[0], col[1]);
      mstore.freeColumn(col[0], col[1]);
      expect(island).toBeGreaterThan(0);
      expect(lo).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(193);
      expect(hi).toBeLessThanOrEqual(263);
      expect(lo).toBeGreaterThan(ISLAND_RUN_MIN_BOTTOM);
      // Over the sea, the sea under some island positions holds water (today's rule would leave dry holes).
      if (col !== LAND_EDGE) expect(wetUnder).toBeGreaterThan(0);
      expect(islandPositions).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    },
  );
});

describe('compiled == reference and probe == bulk on island columns (SP3e spec §3.3)', () => {
  const store = newStore();

  test('every voxel of y 184-272 plus 512 uniform voxels, and every corner of the cells ck 31-41, of the m = 1 and 0.25 < m < 1 sea columns', () => {
    const c = dc.compiled;
    const interp = interpolatedNodes(dc.expr).map((n) => ({ inner: n.x, slot: c.interpolatedSlot(n) }));
    expect(interp).toHaveLength(2);
    const out = new Float64Array(98304);
    const mask = new Uint8Array(98304);
    const r = new Xoshiro128(fnv1a32('floatingIslands.compiled'));
    let voxels = 0, masked = 0, corners = 0, islandVoxels = 0;
    for (const col of [SEA_CORE, SEA_EDGE]) {
      const [cx, cz] = col;
      const view = generate(ctx, store, col);
      terrainDensityDebug(ctx, cx, cz, out, mask);
      const s = dc.column(cx, cz);
      const idx: number[] = [];
      for (let y = 184; y <= 272; y++) for (let p = 0; p < 256; p++) idx.push(((y + 64) << 8) | p);
      for (let n = 0; n < 512; n++) idx.push(256 + r.nextInt(98304 - 256));
      for (const i of idx) {
        const lx = i & 15, lz = (i >> 4) & 15, y = (i >> 8) - 64;
        const x = 16 * cx + lx, z = 16 * cz + lz;
        const value = probe(dc, x, y, z);
        const block = view.block(lx, y, lz);
        voxels++;
        expect(value > 0, `(${x}, ${y}, ${z}) probe ${value}, block ${block}`).toBe(block !== AIR);
        if (y >= 193 && y <= 263 && block !== AIR) islandVoxels++;
        if (mask[i] === 1) {
          masked++;
          expect(Object.is(value, out[i]), `(${x}, ${y}, ${z}) probe ${value} ≠ bulk ${out[i]}`).toBe(true);
        }
        const rv = ref.voxel(s, x, y, z);
        expect(Object.is(value, rv), `(${x}, ${y}, ${z}) compiled ${value} ≠ reference ${rv}`).toBe(true);
      }
      for (let ck = 31; ck <= 41; ck++) {
        for (let cj = 0; cj < 4; cj++) {
          for (let ci = 0; ci < 4; ci++) {
            c.cellCorners(ci, ck, cj);
            for (const { inner, slot } of interp) {
              for (let d = 0; d < 8; d++) {
                const ii = ci + (d & 1), kk = ck + ((d >> 2) & 1), jj = cj + ((d >> 1) & 1);
                const cv = c.cornerValues[cornerValueIndex(slot, ii, kk, jj)]!;
                const rc = ref.corner(s, inner, ii, kk, jj);
                corners++;
                expect(Object.is(cv, rc), `(${cx}, ${cz}) corner (${ii}, ${kk}, ${jj}) compiled ${cv} ≠ reference ${rc}`).toBe(true);
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
      store.freeColumn(cx, cz);
    }
    expect(voxels).toBe(2 * (89 * 256 + 512));
    expect(masked).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(corners).toBe(2 * 11 * 16 * 2 * 8);
    expect(islandVoxels).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  });
});
```

SP2b (its spec §7): perturbations per kind (number and int ±15 % of \|v\| or of the range span, noise wavelength, every numeric spline knot by 15 % of the y span, box intervals shrunk and grown by 15 %); the stage output hash of the leaf's home stage (climate, shape or biome2d); 16 class columns chosen by the lattice conditions under which leaves act (land, coast, channel, gorge, basin, rim and one per lake gate), and bounded witnesses for leaves no class column decides (amended by SP2b). SP3b adds the `terrain` stage: its output hash is the region hash of one column after `fillColumnT`, tried at the land and coast class columns only, with no witness search, and every `density.*` leaf must be decided (amended by SP3b). SP3c adds five class columns for the terrain stage's `surface.*` leaves (`cliffY`, `cliffSteep`, `snowline`, `patch`, `badlands`; 21 class columns), found by a third pass over the same stream after SP2b's two so the existing 16 stay, each accepted only when every leaf it serves changes a voxel of the generated column; every `surface.*` leaf must be decided (amended by SP3c). SP3d: a `json` leaf's perturbation is pinned per leaf (`density.defs`: the `terrain` tap muted to 0; `surface.rules`: the deepslate gradient's upper bound 8 → 12), decided on the land column; U2 covers 68 leaves (amended by SP3d). SP3e: a `bool` leaf's perturbation is its negation; the islands leaves are decided on a floating_islands island column; U2 covers 72 leaves (amended by SP3e) | 100% |
```diff
+| U2 | param liveness: ±15% on each non-live param changes its stage output hash in ≥ 1 of 16 columns. SP3b adds the `terrain` stage: its output hash is the region hash of one column after `fillColumnT`, tried at the land and coast class columns only, with no witness search, and every `density.*` leaf must be decided (amended by SP3b). SP3c adds five class columns for the terrain stage's `surface.*` leaves (`cliffY`, `cliffSteep`, `snowline`, `patch`, `badlands`; 21 class columns), found by a third pass over the same stream after SP2b's two so the existing 16 stay, each accepted only when every leaf it serves changes a voxel of the generated column; every `surface.*` leaf must be decided (amended by SP3c). SP3d: a `json` leaf's perturbation is pinned per leaf (`density.defs`: the `terrain` tap muted to 0; `surface.rules`: the deepslate gradient's upper bound 8 → 12), decided on the land column; U2 covers 68 leaves (amended by SP3d). SP3e: a `bool` leaf's perturbation is its negation; the islands leaves are decided on a floating_islands island column; U2 covers 73 leaves (amended by SP3e) | 100% |
```

```diff
diff --git a/src/core/params/presetTrees.ts b/src/core/params/presetTrees.ts
index afa7e36..8778129 100644
--- a/src/core/params/presetTrees.ts
+++ b/src/core/params/presetTrees.ts
@@ -120,3 +120,41 @@ export const AMPLIFIED_DENSITY_TREE: JsonValue = deriveTree(DEFAULT_DENSITY_TREE
   { path: 'root.a.a.x.x.b.x.a.v', was: 2, by: 3 },
   { path: 'root.a.a.x.x.b.x.b.b.b.v', was: -296, by: -270 },
 ]);
+
+const y = (): JsonValue => ({ op: 'y' });
+const add = (a: JsonValue, b: JsonValue): JsonValue => ({ op: 'add', a, b });
+const mul = (a: JsonValue, b: JsonValue): JsonValue => ({ op: 'mul', a, b });
+const rangeChoice = (x: JsonValue, lo: number, hi: number, inside: JsonValue, outside: JsonValue): JsonValue =>
+  ({ op: 'rangeChoice', x, lo, hi, inside, outside });
+
+/**
+ * floating_islands' islands term (SP3e spec §3.1, D3, D4): BODY = 20·(NI − 0.9 − 3·q + 4·(m − 1)), q = ((y − 230)·0.025)²
+ * (no subtraction or division in the op set; 0.025 is the double nearest 1/40), m = `col islandMask`, NI the
+ * `density.noises.islands` noise. Inside `interpolated` (NI sampled at the 4 × 8 × 4 corners only), gated by
+ * `rangeChoice` on m ≥ 0.25 and on the corner y in [192, 265) (the corners 192 … 264), −1e6 elsewhere. With a = 3 ≥
+ * clampSigma, k = 4 and c = 0.9 both gates are exact (§3.2: BODY ≤ 0 at the corners 184, 264 + 8 and beyond, and
+ * wherever m ≤ 0.475), so island voxels lie in y 193-263, above `ISLAND_RUN_MIN_BOTTOM`.
+ */
+const ISLANDS_TERM: JsonValue = {
+  op: 'interpolated',
+  x: rangeChoice(col('islandMask'), 0.25, 2,
+    rangeChoice(y(), 192, 265,
+      mul(num(20), add(
+        add(
+          add({ op: 'noise', id: 'islands' }, num(-0.9)),
+          { op: 'neg', x: mul(num(3), { op: 'square', x: mul(add(y(), num(-230)), num(0.025)) }) },
+        ),
+        mul(num(4), add(col('islandMask'), num(-1))),
+      )),
+      num(-1000000)),
+    num(-1000000)),
+};
+
+/**
+ * floating_islands (SP3e spec §3.1): the default density tree with the islands tap's child `root.b.x` (const −1e6)
+ * replaced by the islands term. The root stays `max(add(tap terrain, detail), tap islands)`; the tap stays outside
+ * `interpolated`, so its child is a sibling of the terrain's `interpolated` and its mute writes −1e6. 87 nodes.
+ */
+export const FLOATING_DENSITY_TREE: JsonValue = deriveTree(DEFAULT_DENSITY_TREE, 'density.defs', 'density', [
+  { path: 'root.b.x', was: num(-1000000), by: ISLANDS_TERM },
+]);
```

Create `test/unit/floatingRules.test.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * floating_islands' surface rules (SP3e spec §4.1-§4.3, D6, D7, D21 (a)): `FLOATING_SURFACE_RULES` = the default rules
 * with the islands branch inserted at `root.rules[1].then.rules[0]`, its `minY` built from `ISLAND_RUN_MIN_BOTTOM`:
 * - the tree: identity across `resolveProfile`, exactly the insertion (U2's pinned `root.rules[2]` is still the
 *   deepslate gradient), 180 nodes, tier 2 [], rules column cost 2,396,160, a sky-gated fast path with
 *   `maxSurfaceDepth` = 4 + SD_MAX and the default's bands;
 * - a constructed column on a floating_islands ColumnSample: grass tops, dirt for the position's surface depth, a
 *   3-voxel stone underside, the rest of the skin stone, thin islands grass-topped, a stacked island in band stone
 *   (D21 (a)), the ground under islands in band stone; runs the predicate refuses keep the default palette, and an
 *   overhang lip above y 180 takes the island palette (§4.1: the predicate is wider than an island run);
 * - real columns of seed 42 (`floatingIslands.test.ts`' fixtures): the stage's states (compiled, fast path) equal the
 *   reference evaluator's on the probe's rebuild of the column at every solid voxel, and every island run is
 *   grass-topped.
 */
import { describe, expect, test } from 'vitest';
import { ISLAND_RUN_MIN_BOTTOM } from '../../src/core/constants';
import { canonicalJSON } from '../../src/core/params/canonical';
import { DEFAULT_SURFACE_RULES } from '../../src/core/params/defaultTrees';
import { checkJson, countTreeNodes } from '../../src/core/params/json';
import { FLOATING_DENSITY_TREE, FLOATING_SURFACE_RULES } from '../../src/core/params/presetTrees';
import { resolveProfile } from '../../src/core/params/profiles';
import { seedFromInput } from '../../src/core/seed';
import { biomeId, type SurfaceBiome } from '../../src/gen/biomes/registry';
import { createGenContext, type GenContext } from '../../src/gen/context';
import { createSurfaceContext, type SurfaceContext } from '../../src/gen/surface/context';
import { surfaceProbeColumn } from '../../src/gen/surface/probe';
import { newSurfaceScan, scanColumn, type SurfaceScan } from '../../src/gen/surface/scan';
import { validateRulesSource } from '../../src/gen/surface/source';
import { ruleNodeCount, rulesColumnCost } from '../../src/gen/inspect/cost';
import { validateParamTrees } from '../../src/gen/trees';
import { fillColumnT } from '../../src/metrics/region';
import { treeLints } from '../../src/ui/inspector/form';
import { AIR, GRASS_BLOCK, REGISTRY, STONE } from '../../src/world/blocks/index';
import { createStore } from '../../src/world/store/store';
import { paramsWith } from '../harness/gen';

type Rec = Record<string, unknown>;
const DIRT = REGISTRY.parseStateKey('dirt');
const FLOATING = resolveProfile('floating_islands');
const ctx: GenContext = createGenContext(seedFromInput('42'), FLOATING);
/** The same params with the default rules: what the islands branch changes is measured against it. */
const ctxDefault: GenContext = createGenContext(seedFromInput('42'), paramsWith({ islands: { enabled: true }, density: { defs: FLOATING_DENSITY_TREE } }));
const sc: SurfaceContext = createSurfaceContext(ctx);
const scDefault: SurfaceContext = createSurfaceContext(ctxDefault);

/** §4.2's branch, written out. */
const BRANCH = {
  kind: 'condition', if: { kind: 'yAbove', minY: 181, runTop: true },
  then: { kind: 'condition', if: { kind: 'stoneDepth', side: 'ceiling', offset: 100, addSurfaceDepth: false },
    then: { kind: 'condition', if: { kind: 'stoneDepth', side: 'floor', offset: 4, addSurfaceDepth: true },
      then: { kind: 'sequence', rules: [
        { kind: 'condition', if: { kind: 'stoneDepth', side: 'floor', offset: 0, addSurfaceDepth: false },
          then: { kind: 'block', state: 'grass_block' } },
        { kind: 'condition', if: { kind: 'stoneDepth', side: 'ceiling', offset: 2, addSurfaceDepth: false },
          then: { kind: 'block', state: 'stone' } },
        { kind: 'condition', if: { kind: 'stoneDepth', side: 'floor', offset: 0, addSurfaceDepth: true },
          then: { kind: 'block', state: 'dirt' } },
        { kind: 'block', state: 'stone' } ] } } } };

const skyChildren = (t: unknown): unknown[] => ((t as { rules: Array<{ then: { rules: unknown[] } }> }).rules[1]!.then.rules);

describe('FLOATING_SURFACE_RULES (SP3e spec §4.2, §4.3, D6, D7)', () => {
  test('the overlay holds the registered tree; resolveProfile keeps its identity; checkJson returns it as itself', () => {
    expect(FLOATING.surface.rules).toBe(FLOATING_SURFACE_RULES);
    expect(resolveProfile('floating_islands').surface.rules).toBe(FLOATING_SURFACE_RULES);
    expect(Object.isFrozen(FLOATING_SURFACE_RULES)).toBe(true);
    expect(checkJson(FLOATING_SURFACE_RULES, 'surface.rules', [], 'surfaceRules')).toBe(FLOATING_SURFACE_RULES);
  });

  test('exactly the insertion at root.rules[1].then.rules[0]; the default\'s children follow at 1-5; rules[0], [2] unchanged', () => {
    const t = FLOATING_SURFACE_RULES as unknown as { rules: unknown[] };
    const d = DEFAULT_SURFACE_RULES as unknown as { rules: unknown[] };
    expect(t.rules).toHaveLength(3);
    expect(canonicalJSON(skyChildren(t)[0])).toBe(canonicalJSON(BRANCH));
    expect(skyChildren(t)).toHaveLength(6);
    skyChildren(d).forEach((c, k) => expect(canonicalJSON(skyChildren(t)[k + 1]), `child ${k}`).toBe(canonicalJSON(c)));
    // Removing the branch gives the default tree back.
    const copy = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(FLOATING_SURFACE_RULES)) as unknown;
    skyChildren(copy).splice(0, 1);
    expect(canonicalJSON(copy)).toBe(canonicalJSON(DEFAULT_SURFACE_RULES));
    // U2's pinned surface.rules variant path ['rules', 2, 'if'] still names the deepslate gradient.
    expect((t.rules[2] as Rec)['if']).toEqual({ kind: 'verticalGradient', trueAtAndBelow: 0, falseAtAndAbove: 8 });
    expect(canonicalJSON(t.rules[0])).toBe(canonicalJSON(d.rules[0]));
  });

  test('the branch\'s minY literal is ISLAND_RUN_MIN_BOTTOM (one constant, §4.1)', () => {
    const minY = ((skyChildren(FLOATING_SURFACE_RULES)[0] as Rec)['if'] as Rec)['minY'];
    expect(minY).toBe(ISLAND_RUN_MIN_BOTTOM);
    expect(minY).toBe(181);
  });

  test('180 nodes (the default 163 + the branch 17); tier 2 []; rules column cost 2,396,160; no lint', () => {
    expect(countTreeNodes(FLOATING_SURFACE_RULES, 'surfaceRules')).toBe(180);
    expect(countTreeNodes(BRANCH, 'surfaceRules')).toBe(17);
    expect(ruleNodeCount(FLOATING_SURFACE_RULES)).toBe(180);
    expect(validateRulesSource(FLOATING_SURFACE_RULES)).toEqual([]);
    expect(validateParamTrees(FLOATING)).toEqual([]);
    expect(rulesColumnCost(FLOATING_SURFACE_RULES)).toBe(2_396_160);
    expect(rulesColumnCost(FLOATING_SURFACE_RULES)).toBe(180 * 256 * 52);
    expect(treeLints(FLOATING)).toEqual([]);
  });

  test('a sky-gated fast path with maxSurfaceDepth = 4 + SD_MAX and the default\'s bands', () => {
    const fp = sc.compiled.fastPath;
    expect(fp).not.toBeNull();
    expect(fp!.skyGated).toBe(true);
    expect(fp!.maxSurfaceDepth).toBe(4 + sc.settings.sdMax);
    expect(fp!.bands).toEqual(scDefault.compiled.fastPath!.bands);
  });
});

/**
 * One constructed column per position p, case p % 10 (y ranges inclusive, every position also holds the stage's
 * bedrock at y −64, which the scan ignores):
 */
const CASES: ReadonlyArray<{ readonly name: string; readonly runs: ReadonlyArray<readonly [bottom: number, top: number]>; readonly water?: readonly [number, number] }> = [
  { name: 'an island over the sea', runs: [[-63, 40], [200, 230]], water: [41, 63] },
  { name: 'an island over nothing', runs: [[220, 240]] },
  { name: 'a one-voxel island over ground', runs: [[-63, 70], [200, 200]] },
  { name: 'a two-voxel island over ground', runs: [[-63, 70], [200, 201]] },
  { name: 'a stacked island (two islands over ground)', runs: [[-63, 70], [200, 215], [240, 255]] },
  { name: 'an island whose bottom voxel is 181', runs: [[-63, 70], [181, 190]] },
  { name: 'a peak resting on the bedrock', runs: [[-63, 250]] },
  { name: 'a detached run whose top is 180', runs: [[-63, 70], [150, 180]] },
  { name: 'an overhang lip above y 180 (bottom 150)', runs: [[-63, 70], [150, 200]] },
  { name: 'a detached run thicker than 100 (100 … 250)', runs: [[-63, 70], [100, 250]] },
];
/** The cases whose topmost run takes the island branch. */
const BRANCH_CASES = new Set([0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 8]);
/** The ground biomes cycled over the positions: none of them reaches an island (D7). */
const GROUND_BIOMES: readonly SurfaceBiome[] = ['desert', 'warm_ocean', 'snowy_plains', 'frozen_peaks', 'plains', 'badlands', 'beach'];
const at = (p: number, y: number): number => ((y + 64) << 8) | p;

/** §4.2's island palette at voxel y of a run [bottom, top] with surface depth sd. */
const islandState = (y: number, bottom: number, top: number, sd: number): number =>
  y === top ? GRASS_BLOCK : y - bottom <= 2 ? STONE : top - y <= sd ? DIRT : STONE;

describe('the islands branch on a constructed column (SP3e spec §4.1, §4.2, D21 (a))', () => {
  // A real floating_islands ColumnSample for the readouts the scan takes (steep, T, lake level, surface depth): column
  // (10, 10), whose surface depth is 4-7 at seed 42, so the dirt layer shows.
  const s = sc.density.columns.get(10, 10);
  const solid = new Uint8Array(98304), water = new Uint8Array(98304), biomes = new Uint8Array(256);
  for (let p = 0; p < 256; p++) {
    const c = CASES[p % CASES.length]!;
    solid[at(p, -64)] = 1;
    for (const [b, t] of c.runs) for (let y = b; y <= t; y++) solid[at(p, y)] = 1;
    if (c.water !== undefined) for (let y = c.water[0]; y <= c.water[1]; y++) water[at(p, y)] = 1;
    biomes[p] = biomeId(GROUND_BIOMES[p % GROUND_BIOMES.length]!);
  }
  const scan: SurfaceScan = scanColumn(newSurfaceScan(), sc.settings, s, solid, water, biomes);
  const fast = new Uint16Array(98304), full = new Uint16Array(98304), dflt = new Uint16Array(98304);
  sc.compiled.fillColumn(scan, fast, true);
  sc.compiled.fillColumn(scan, full, false);
  scDefault.compiled.fillColumn(scan, dflt, true);

  test('fast path == full evaluation == the reference evaluator at every solid voxel', () => {
    let n = 0;
    for (let p = 0; p < 256; p++) {
      for (let y = -63; y <= 319; y++) {
        const i = at(p, y);
        if (solid[i] === 0) continue;
        const ref = sc.reference.state(scan, sc.settings, p, y);
        expect(fast[i], `p ${p} y ${y}`).toBe(ref);
        expect(full[i], `p ${p} y ${y}`).toBe(ref);
        n++;
      }
    }
    expect(n).toBeGreaterThan(256 * 100);
  });

  test.each(CASES.map((c, k) => [c.name, k] as const))('%s', (_name, k) => {
    let positions = 0, dirt = 0;
    for (let p = k; p < 256; p += CASES.length) {
      positions++;
      const runs = CASES[k]!.runs;
      const sd = scan.surfaceDepth[p]!;
      // The topmost run is the sky-open one.
      const [bottom, top] = runs[runs.length - 1]!;
      for (let y = bottom; y <= top; y++) {
        const got = fast[at(p, y)]!;
        if (BRANCH_CASES.has(k)) {
          expect(got, `p ${p} y ${y} sd ${sd}`).toBe(islandState(y, bottom, top, sd));
          if (got === DIRT) dirt++;
        } else {
          // The predicate refuses it: the default palette, voxel for voxel.
          expect(got, `p ${p} y ${y}`).toBe(dflt[at(p, y)]);
        }
      }
      // Every lower run is not sky-open: the band state (stone at y ≥ 8; D21 (a): the ground and a stacked island
      // under an island are bare stone), as with the default rules.
      for (const [b, t] of runs.slice(0, -1)) {
        for (let y = b; y <= t; y++) expect(fast[at(p, y)], `p ${p} y ${y}`).toBe(dflt[at(p, y)]);
        if (t >= 8) expect(fast[at(p, t)], `p ${p} run top ${t}`).toBe(STONE);
      }
    }
    expect(positions).toBeGreaterThan(20);
    // Thick islands show the dirt layer (surface depth 4-7 here).
    if (k === 0 || k === 1 || k === 4) expect(dirt).toBeGreaterThan(positions * 3);
  });

  test('the ground biome never reaches an island: its default top would be sand, snow or stone on some positions', () => {
    const tops = new Set<number>();
    for (let p = 0; p < 256; p += CASES.length) tops.add(dflt[at(p, 230)]!);
    expect([...tops].some((v) => v !== GRASS_BLOCK)).toBe(true);
    for (let p = 0; p < 256; p += CASES.length) expect(fast[at(p, 230)]).toBe(GRASS_BLOCK);
  });
});

describe('compiled == reference and probe == bulk on real floating_islands columns (seed 42; SP3e spec §4.3)', () => {
  /** floatingIslands.test.ts' fixtures: SEA_CORE (m = 1), SEA_EDGE (0.25 < m < 1), LAND_EDGE (land). */
  const COLUMNS: ReadonlyArray<readonly [number, number]> = [[19358, -22222], [2012, -10108], [504, -28536]];
  const store = createStore({ shared: false, maxBlockBytes: 8 << 20, maxByteBytes: 8 << 20 });
  const probeSc = createSurfaceContext(ctx);

  test.each(COLUMNS.map((c) => [`${c[0]}, ${c[1]}`, c] as const))('(%s): every solid voxel; every island run grass-topped', (_name, [cx, cz]) => {
    expect(fillColumnT(store, ctx, cx, cz, () => false)).toBe(true);
    const view = store.proto(cx, cz)!;
    const c = surfaceProbeColumn(probeSc, cx, cz);
    let voxels = 0, islandRuns = 0;
    for (let p = 0; p < 256; p++) {
      const lx = p & 15, lz = p >> 4;
      for (let y = -63; y <= 319; y++) {
        const block = view.block(lx, y, lz);
        expect(c.solid[at(p, y)] !== 0, `(${lx}, ${y}, ${lz})`).toBe(block !== AIR);
        if (block === AIR) continue;
        voxels++;
        const ref = probeSc.reference.state(c.scan, probeSc.settings, p, y);
        expect(block, `(${lx}, ${y}, ${lz}) stage ${block} ≠ reference ${ref}`).toBe(ref);
        expect(probeSc.compiled.state(c.scan, p, y), `(${lx}, ${y}, ${lz})`).toBe(ref);
      }
      for (let r = c.scan.runFirst[p]!; r < c.scan.runFirst[p + 1]!; r++) {
        if (c.scan.runBottom[r]! < ISLAND_RUN_MIN_BOTTOM) continue;
        islandRuns++;
        // D21 (a): only the sky-open (first) run takes the branch; a stacked island below it is band stone.
        const want = r === c.scan.runFirst[p] ? GRASS_BLOCK : STONE;
        expect(view.block(lx, c.scan.runTop[r]!, lz), `(${lx}, ${c.scan.runTop[r]}, ${lz})`).toBe(want);
      }
    }
    store.freeColumn(cx, cz);
    expect(voxels).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(islandRuns).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  });
});
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, test } from 'vitest';
import { ARCHIPELAGO_BIOME_TABLE, BIOME_TABLE_DEFAULT, BOX_BIOMES } from '../../src/core/params/biomeDefaults';
import { canonicalJSON } from '../../src/core/params/canonical';
import { DEFAULTS } from '../../src/core/params/defaults';
import { resolveProfile } from '../../src/core/params/profiles';
import { ARCHIPELAGO_JAG, ARCHIPELAGO_OFFSET, ARCHIPELAGO_SIGMA, JAG_DEFAULT, OFFSET_DEFAULT, SIGMA_DEFAULT } from '../../src/core/params/shapeDefaults';
import { seedFromInput } from '../../src/core/seed';
import { autoTangents } from '../../src/core/spline/tangents';
import type { NestedSpline } from '../../src/core/spline/types';
import { newClimate, sampleClimate } from '../../src/gen/column/climate';
import { columnPoint } from '../../src/gen/column/columnPoint';
import { lakeCell } from '../../src/gen/column/lakes';
import { newShape, sampleShape } from '../../src/gen/column/shape';
import { createGenContext } from '../../src/gen/context';
import { validateParamTrees } from '../../src/gen/trees';
import { waterRaster } from '../../src/metrics/columnStats';
import { testFloat, testRng } from '../harness/stats';

/**
 * The archipelago preset (SP3e spec §1.3, D8): the default C-keyed values carried through the C map φ with shift
 * 0.42, written as literals. φ's literals at the default values that occur (spec §1.3's table): the test checks the
 * preset against φ of the defaults, so a knot that drifts from either the spec or the default is caught.
 */
const PHI = new Map<number, number>([
  [-1, -1], [-0.6, -0.39], [-0.4, -0.05], [-0.24, 0.18], [-0.16, 0.26], [-0.1, 0.32], [0.05, 0.47],
  [-0.55, -0.305], [-0.22, 0.2], [-0.04, 0.38], [-0.12, 0.3], [-0.02, 0.4], [1, 1],
]);
const phi = (c: number): number => {
  const v = PHI.get(c);
  if (v === undefined) throw new Error(`no φ literal for ${c}`);
  return v;
};

const ARCHIPELAGO = resolveProfile('archipelago');
const CTX = createGenContext(seedFromInput('42'), ARCHIPELAGO);

/** Every numeric knot of a nested spline, keyed by its path (`C 0.47 / E 0.2 / PV -1`), as terrainRetune.test.ts. */
function knotYs(s: NestedSpline, prefix = ''): Record<string, number> {
  const out: Record<string, number> = {};
  for (const p of s.points) {
    const key = `${prefix}${s.coord} ${p.x}`;
    if (typeof p.y === 'number') out[key] = p.y;
    else Object.assign(out, knotYs(p.y, `${key} / `));
  }
  return out;
}

/** Tangents are autoTangents' (recomputed from the knots with every d zeroed). */
function zeroD(s: NestedSpline): NestedSpline {
  return { coord: s.coord, points: s.points.map((p) => ({ x: p.x, y: typeof p.y === 'number' ? p.y : zeroD(p.y), d: 0 })) };
}

/** The default's top-level C knots through φ, without those at C ≥ `dropFrom`; nested values kept as they are. */
function throughPhi(s: NestedSpline, dropFrom = Infinity): Array<[number, string]> {
  return s.points.filter((p) => p.x < dropFrom).map((p) => [phi(p.x), canonicalJSON(typeof p.y === 'number' ? p.y : zeroD(p.y))]);
}
const topLevel = (s: NestedSpline): Array<[number, string]> => s.points.map((p) => [p.x, canonicalJSON(typeof p.y === 'number' ? p.y : zeroD(p.y))]);

describe('SP3e archipelago splines (spec §1.3)', () => {
  test('ARCHIPELAGO_OFFSET: §1.3\'s knots and values; the default\'s through φ without its C 0.3 and 0.6 knots', () => {
    expect(knotYs(ARCHIPELAGO_OFFSET)).toEqual({
      'C -1': 16, 'C -0.39': 26, 'C -0.05': 40, 'C 0.18': 52, 'C 0.26': 60,
      'C 0.32 / E -1': 70, 'C 0.32 / E 0': 64, 'C 0.32 / E 1': 63,
      'C 0.47 / E -1 / PV -1': 72, 'C 0.47 / E -1 / PV 0': 96, 'C 0.47 / E -1 / PV 1': 130,
      'C 0.47 / E -0.4 / PV -1': 68, 'C 0.47 / E -0.4 / PV 0': 82, 'C 0.47 / E -0.4 / PV 1': 100,
      'C 0.47 / E 0.2 / PV -1': 72, 'C 0.47 / E 0.2 / PV 0': 84, 'C 0.47 / E 0.2 / PV 1': 98,
      'C 0.47 / E 1': 76,
    });
    expect(topLevel(ARCHIPELAGO_OFFSET)).toEqual(throughPhi(OFFSET_DEFAULT, 0.3));
    expect(canonicalJSON(ARCHIPELAGO_OFFSET)).toBe(canonicalJSON(autoTangents(zeroD(ARCHIPELAGO_OFFSET))));
  });

  test('ARCHIPELAGO_SIGMA and ARCHIPELAGO_JAG: §1.3\'s knots; the defaults through φ', () => {
    expect(knotYs(ARCHIPELAGO_SIGMA)).toEqual({
      'C -1': 3, 'C 0.26': 3, 'C 0.32': 1.5,
      'C 0.47 / E -1 / PV -1': 12, 'C 0.47 / E -1 / PV 1': 26, 'C 0.47 / E 0': 6, 'C 0.47 / E 1': 3,
    });
    expect(knotYs(ARCHIPELAGO_JAG)).toEqual({
      'C 0.32': 0,
      'C 0.47 / E -1 / PV 0.3': 0, 'C 0.47 / E -1 / PV 0.7': 30, 'C 0.47 / E -1 / PV 1': 55,
      'C 0.47 / E -0.5 / PV 0.3': 0, 'C 0.47 / E -0.5 / PV 0.7': 30, 'C 0.47 / E -0.5 / PV 1': 55,
      'C 0.47 / E -0.4': 0,
    });
    expect(topLevel(ARCHIPELAGO_SIGMA)).toEqual(throughPhi(SIGMA_DEFAULT));
    expect(topLevel(ARCHIPELAGO_JAG)).toEqual(throughPhi(JAG_DEFAULT));
    for (const s of [ARCHIPELAGO_SIGMA, ARCHIPELAGO_JAG]) expect(canonicalJSON(s)).toBe(canonicalJSON(autoTangents(zeroD(s))));
  });
});

describe('SP3e archipelago biome table (spec §1.3)', () => {
  test('the default with exactly the C bounds of §1.3\'s table changed', () => {
    const changed: Record<string, readonly [number, number]> = {};
    for (const b of BOX_BIOMES) {
      const a = ARCHIPELAGO_BIOME_TABLE[b];
      const d = BIOME_TABLE_DEFAULT[b];
      expect({ ...a, C: d.C }, b).toEqual(d);
      expect(a.C, b).toEqual([phi(d.C[0]), phi(d.C[1])]);

describe('SP3e archipelago overlay (spec §1.1)', () => {
  test('resolves to the default plus exactly C λ 840, the three splines, the coast fade, lakes.minC and the table', () => {

    expect(canonicalJSON(p.shape)).toBe(canonicalJSON({ offset: ARCHIPELAGO_OFFSET, sigma: ARCHIPELAGO_SIGMA, jag: ARCHIPELAGO_JAG }));

describe('SP3e archipelago shore (spec §1.3, seed 42)', () => {
  test('10⁴ points over ±2^19: C_u < 0.2 is ocean, offset0 crosses 63 only at C_u in [0.26, 0.32], C ≥ 0.47 has offset0 ≤ 130', () => {
    const next = testRng(3108);
    const c = newClimate();
    const sh = newShape();
    const coords = new Float64Array(6);
    let below = 0;
    let shoreSea = 0;
    let shoreLand = 0;
    let shoreEmin = 1;
    let shoreEmax = -1;
    let inland = 0;
    let maxInland = -Infinity;
    for (let i = 0; i < 10000; i++) {
      // columnPoint's C and offset0 (climate then shape; rivers and lakes do not move offset0).
      const p = { C: 0, E: 0, offset0: 0 };
      sampleClimate(CTX, -524288 + 1048576 * testFloat(next), -524288 + 1048576 * testFloat(next), c);
      [p.C, p.E, p.offset0] = [c.C, c.E, sampleShape(CTX, c, coords, sh).offset0];
      if (p.C < 0.2) below++;
      if (p.C < 0.26) expect(p.offset0, `C ${p.C}`).toBeLessThan(63);
      else if (p.C >= 0.32) expect(p.offset0, `C ${p.C}`).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(63);
      else {
        if (p.offset0 < 63) shoreSea++;
        else shoreLand++;
        shoreEmin = Math.min(shoreEmin, p.E);
        shoreEmax = Math.max(shoreEmax, p.E);
      }
      if (p.C >= 0.47) {
        inland++;
        maxInland = Math.max(maxInland, p.offset0);
      }
    }
    // Every case is reached: the C < 0.2 ocean, both sides of 63 inside the shore band across E, and the inland plateau.
    expect(below).toBeGreaterThan(1000);
    expect([shoreSea > 0, shoreLand > 0, shoreEmin < -0.5, shoreEmax > 0.5]).toEqual([true, true, true, true]);
    expect(inland).toBeGreaterThan(1000);
    expect(maxInland).toBeLessThanOrEqual(130);
  });

  test('a 128² waterRaster at step 64 centred on (0, 0) is 55-80 % ocean (offset0 < 63; smoke)', () => {
    const n = 128;
    const w = waterRaster(CTX, -32 * n, -32 * n, n, 64);
    let sea = 0;
    for (let k = 0; k < n * n; k++) if (w.offset0[k]! < 63) sea++;
    const share = sea / (n * n);
    expect(share).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0.55);
    expect(share).toBeLessThanOrEqual(0.8);
  });
});

/**
 * Lakes below the sea beside it (SP3e spec §1.3, Review Focus): a lake's level Lw is the ring's lowest offset0 − 1 (master
 * §3.5), so on archipelago's low land a lake near the shore can sit far below the sea 8 blocks away. Water v0 has no
 * flow, so the sea column stands as a wall of water above the lake (or its dry basin) until SP7's settle; the spec
 * states it and these counts pin it. Per enabled lake cell with Lw < 62: the largest 63 − Lw over the basin columns
 * (lakeMask 1, its Lw) on an 8-block grid around the cell centre that have a sea neighbour 8 blocks away (lakeMask 0,
 * surfaceWaterLevel 63). A lake column holds water up to Lw or is dry, so 63 − Lw is the step from the sea to it.
 */
describe('SP3e archipelago lakes beside the sea (spec §1.3, seed 42, cells i, j in [−30, 30))', () => {
  const steps = (params: typeof DEFAULTS) => {
    const ctx = createGenContext(seedFromInput('42'), params);
    let lakes = 0, below = 0, low = 0;
    const found: number[] = [];
    for (let i = -30; i < 30; i++) {
      for (let j = -30; j < 30; j++) {
        const cell = lakeCell(ctx, i, j);
        if (!cell.enabled) continue;
        lakes++;
        if (cell.Lw < 63) below++;
        if (cell.Lw >= 62) continue;
        low++;
        const x0 = Math.round(cell.cx), z0 = Math.round(cell.cz);
        const seen = new Map<string, { m: number; level: number; water: number }>();
        const at = (x: number, z: number) => {
          const k = `${x},${z}`;
          let p = seen.get(k);
          if (p === undefined) {
            const r = columnPoint(ctx, x, z);
            p = { m: r.lakeMask, level: r.lakeLevel, water: r.surfaceWaterLevel };
            seen.set(k, p);
          }
          return p;
        };
        let step = -Infinity;
        for (let dx = -192; dx <= 192; dx += 8) {
          for (let dz = -192; dz <= 192; dz += 8) {
            const p = at(x0 + dx, z0 + dz);
            if (p.m !== 1 || p.level !== cell.Lw) continue;
            for (const [ex, ez] of [[8, 0], [-8, 0], [0, 8], [0, -8]] as const) {
              const q = at(x0 + dx + ex, z0 + dz + ez);
              if (q.m === 0 && q.water === 63) step = Math.max(step, 63 - cell.Lw);
            }
          }
        }
        if (step >= 3) found.push(step);
      }
    }
    return { lakes, below, low, stepped: found.length, max: Math.max(0, ...found) };
  };

  test('archipelago has about 3 × the default\'s share of lakes below the sea, and twice its deepest step beside it', () => {
    const arch = steps(ARCHIPELAGO), base = steps(DEFAULTS);
    expect(arch).toEqual({ lakes: 105, below: 28, low: 25, stepped: 8, max: 40 });
    expect(base).toEqual({ lakes: 164, below: 14, low: 9, stepped: 2, max: 18 });
    expect(arch.below / arch.lakes).toBeGreaterThan(3 * (base.below / base.lakes));
  }, 60_000);
});
```

Create `test/unit/terrainScatter.test.ts`:

```ts
import { afterEach, describe, expect, test, vi } from 'vitest';
import { biomeId } from '../../src/gen/biomes/registry';
import { AIR } from '../../src/world/blocks/index';
import {
  analyseColumn, newScatterScratch, newScattered, t1Values, t2Values, t3Values, t5Values, type ScatterColumn, type Scattered,
} from '../harness/terrainScatter';

/**
 * T1-T5's per-column analysis and part bodies, extracted from terrain.metric.ts (SP3e spec §5.1 "Extractions", §5.5):
 * constructed columns, the record mode's populations and the enforce mode's soft-failure messages. The extraction's
 * proof on real columns is the quick tier's Equal-set diff (T1-T5 unchanged).
 */

const SOLID = AIR + 1;
const PLAINS = biomeId('plains');
const FOREST = biomeId('forest');
const STONY = biomeId('stony_peaks');

/** A column from a per-position solidity rule and its aux A heightmaps (`ws`, `of`) and biomes. */
function column(
  solid: (p: number, y: number) => boolean,
  ws: (p: number) => number,
  of: (p: number) => number,
  biome: (p: number) => number,
): ScatterColumn {
  const sections = Array.from({ length: 24 }, (_, sy) => {
    const b = new Uint16Array(4096);
    for (let i = 0; i < 4096; i++) b[i] = solid(i & 255, sy * 16 - 64 + (i >> 8)) ? SOLID : AIR;
    return b;
  });
  const aux = {
    worldSurfaceWG: Int16Array.from({ length: 256 }, (_, p) => ws(p)),
    oceanFloorWG: Int16Array.from({ length: 256 }, (_, p) => of(p)),
    surfaceBiome: Uint8Array.from({ length: 256 }, (_, p) => biome(p)),
  };
  return { sectionBlocks: (sy) => sections[sy]!, aux: () => aux };
}

/**
 * Ground to y 70 everywhere (top 70, WS = OF = 71) except: position 0 is sea (floor 40, WS 64 ≠ OF 41); position 1
 * has an overhang (air at 60-62 under a roof up to 70: transitions at 59 and 70, both ≥ top − 30 = 40); position 34
 * (lx 2, lz 2) has a cave at 30-32 (transitions at 29 and 70: 29 < 40, not an overhang, but two transitions at y ≥ −56); position 3
 * holds a 4-block rock (y 80-83) on a 9-block air gap above its top, which is then 83 (ws 84). Biomes: x < 8 plains,
 * x ≥ 8 forest, row z = 15 stony peaks.
 */
function testColumn(): ScatterColumn {
  const top = (p: number): number => (p === 0 ? 40 : p === 3 ? 83 : 70);
  return column(
    (p, y) => {
      if (y > top(p)) return false;
      if (p === 1 && y >= 60 && y <= 62) return false;
      if (p === 34 && y >= 30 && y <= 32) return false;
      if (p === 3 && y > 70 && y < 80) return false;
      return true;
    },
    (p) => (p === 0 ? 64 : top(p) + 1),
    (p) => top(p) + 1,
    (p) => ((p >> 4) === 15 ? STONY : (p & 15) < 8 ? PLAINS : FOREST),
  );
}

describe('analyseColumn (T1-T5 per column)', () => {
  const s = newScattered();
  const seen: Array<[number, number]> = [];
  analyseColumn(s, testColumn(), 3, -2, (x, z) => { seen.push([x, z]); return 75; }, newScatterScratch());

  test('land = WORLD_SURFACE_WG === OCEAN_FLOOR_WG; the top is WS − 1', () => {
    expect(s.columns).toBe(1);
    expect(s.waterPositions).toBe(1);
    expect(s.land).toBe(255);
    expect(s.hist[70 + 64]).toBe(254);
    expect(s.hist[83 + 64]).toBe(1);
    expect(s.hist[40 + 64]).toBe(0);
  });

  test("T2: ≥ 2 solid→air transitions at y ≥ top − 30 (the cave's lower transition is below it)", () => {
    // Positions 1 (the roof) and 3 (the rock: transitions at 70 and 83 ≥ 53); not 34 (29 < 40).
    expect(s.over).toBe(2);
    expect(s.peakLand).toBe(16);
    expect(s.peakColumns).toBe(1);
    expect(s.peakOver).toBe(0);
  });

  test('floating rocks: a run ≤ 6 high on an air gap ≥ 3', () => {
    expect(s.floatPositions).toBe(1);
    expect(s.floatVoxels).toBe(4);
    expect(s.peakFloatPositions).toBe(0);
  });

  test('T5: land positions with exactly one transition at y ≥ −56, at lx, lz ∈ {2, 6, 10, 14}', () => {
    // 16 positions, all land; position 34 (lx 2, lz 2) holds the cave (two transitions).
    expect(s.t5Land).toBe(16);
    expect(s.t5Multi).toBe(1);
    expect(s.t5).toEqual(Array.from({ length: 15 }, () => 5));
    expect(seen).toHaveLength(15);
    expect(seen).toContainEqual([16 * 3 + 6, 16 * -2 + 14]);
    expect(seen).not.toContainEqual([16 * 3 + 2, 16 * -2 + 2]);
  });

  test('T3: land neighbour pairs inside the column, by biome', () => {
    // 240 pairs per axis; the sea position 0 drops its two pairs.
    expect(s.landPairs).toBe(478);
    // plains | forest at x 7-8 on rows 0-14 (15 pairs): same family (lowland), one border edge.
    const e = PLAINS < FOREST ? (PLAINS << 8) | FOREST : (FOREST << 8) | PLAINS;
    expect(s.borderPairs[e]).toBe(15);
    expect(s.borderSteep[e]).toBe(0);
    // stony peaks (row 15) against plains / forest (row 14): 16 cross-family pairs.
    expect(s.crossFamilyPairs).toBe(16);
    // plains inside: rows 0-14, 7 x-pairs and (rows 0-13) 8 z-pairs per column x < 8, minus position 0's two pairs;
    // steep where position 3 (top 83) meets 2 and 4 (x) and 19 (z).
    expect(s.inside[PLAINS]).toBe(15 * 7 + 14 * 8 - 2);
    expect(s.insideSteep[PLAINS]).toBe(3);
  });

  test('water walls: the sea position has land on both sides above its surface', () => {
    // Water 41-63 (23 voxels); neighbours' WS 72 (positions 1 and 16) → no dry air beside it at those y: walls 0.
    expect(s.water).toBe(23);
    expect(s.walls).toBe(0);
  });
});

/** A Scattered with hand-set accumulators: 10 land tops at 70 and 30 at 100, so p5 = 70, p50 = p95 = 100. */
function filled(): Scattered {
  const s = newScattered();
  s.columns = 1;
  s.land = 40;
  s.hist[70 + 64] = 10;
  s.hist[100 + 64] = 30;
  s.over = 4;
  s.peakLand = 10;
  s.peakOver = 5;
  s.peakColumns = 1;
  s.t5 = [3, 1, 2];
  s.t5Land = 4;
  s.t5Multi = 1;
  const e = (PLAINS << 8) | FOREST;
  s.inside[PLAINS] = 10;
  s.insideSteep[PLAINS] = 1;
  s.inside[FOREST] = 10;
  s.insideSteep[FOREST] = 3;
  s.borderPairs[e] = 5;
  s.borderSteep[e] = 2;
  return s;
}

describe('part bodies', () => {
  test('T1: band, span, shares, quantiles', () => {
    const v = t1Values(filled(), 'enforce', 'default');
    expect(v).toMatchObject({ band: 0.75, span: 30, above120: 0, above200: 0, p5: 70, p50: 100, p95: 100, landPositions: 40, landShare: 40 / 256 });
    expect(Object.keys(v).slice(0, 4)).toEqual(['band', 'span', 'above120', 'above200']);
  });

  test('T2: overhang shares', () => {
    expect(t2Values(filled(), 'record', 'default')).toMatchObject({ overhangs: 0.1, overhangsPeaks: 0.5, peakPositions: 10, peakColumns: 1 });
  });

  test("T3: Σ steep / Σ of the two biomes' inside steep shares, over the lowland pairs", () => {
    const v = t3Values(filled(), 'record', 'default');
    // expected per pair (0.1 + 0.3) / 2 = 0.2 → 5 pairs expect 1 steep, 2 seen.
    expect(v.value).toBeCloseTo(2, 12);
    expect(v['borderPairs']).toBe(5);
    expect(v['familyPairs.lowland']).toBe(5);
  });

  test('T5: nearest-rank quantiles of |surfaceEst3 − top|', () => {
    expect(t5Values(filled(), 'record', 'default')).toMatchObject({ median: 2, p90: 3, p99: 3, max: 3, mean: 2, singleSurface: 3, landPositions: 4, multiSurface: 1 });
  });
});

describe("population modes (SP3e spec §5.5: 'Populations are recorded, never enforced')", () => {
  const messages: string[] = [];
  const spy = (): void => {
    vi.spyOn(expect, 'soft').mockImplementation(((n: number, message?: string) => {
      const assertion = { toBeGreaterThanOrEqual: (min: number) => { if (n < min) messages.push(message ?? ''); } };
      return assertion;
    }) as unknown as typeof expect.soft);
  };
  afterEach(() => { vi.restoreAllMocks(); messages.length = 0; });

  test('record mode: an empty population does not fail and writes <part>.population 0', () => {
    spy();
    const s = newScattered();
    const t1 = t1Values(s, 'record', 'archipelago');
    const t2 = t2Values(s, 'record', 'archipelago');
    const t3 = t3Values(s, 'record', 'archipelago');
    const t5 = t5Values(s, 'record', 'archipelago');
    expect(messages).toEqual([]);
    expect(vi.mocked(expect.soft)).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    for (const part of ['band', 'span', 'above120', 'above200']) expect(t1[`${part}.population`]).toBe(0);
    expect(t2['overhangs.population']).toBe(0);
    expect(t2['overhangsPeaks.population']).toBe(0);
    expect(t3['value.population']).toBe(0);
    for (const part of ['median', 'p90', 'p99']) {
      expect(t5[`${part}.population`]).toBe(0);
      expect(t5[part]).toBeNaN();
    }
  });

  test('record mode writes the populations the minima would read', () => {
    const s = filled();
    expect(t1Values(s, 'record', 'x')['band.population']).toBe(40);
    expect(t2Values(s, 'record', 'x')).toMatchObject({ 'overhangs.population': 40, 'overhangsPeaks.population': 1 });
    expect(t3Values(s, 'record', 'x')['value.population']).toBe(5);
    expect(t5Values(s, 'record', 'x')['median.population']).toBe(3);
  });

  test("enforce mode keeps today's soft-failure messages and writes no population key", () => {
    spy();
    const s = newScattered();
    const all = { ...t1Values(s, 'enforce', 'default'), ...t2Values(s, 'enforce', 'default'), ...t3Values(s, 'enforce', 'default'), ...t5Values(s, 'enforce', 'large_biomes') };
    expect(messages).toEqual([
      'T2.overhangsPeaks (default) peak columns: insufficient sample (0 < 20)',
      'T3 (default) lowland border pairs: insufficient sample (0 < 2000)',
      'T5 (large_biomes) single-surface positions: insufficient sample (0 < 1000)',
    ]);
    expect(Object.keys(all).filter((k) => k.includes('population'))).toEqual([]);
  });
});
```

```ts
import { Worker } from 'node:worker_threads';
import { expect } from 'vitest';
import type { Params } from '../../src/core/params/schema';
import { biomeFamily, biomeId, type BiomeFamily } from '../../src/gen/biomes/registry';
import { AIR } from '../../src/world/blocks/index';
import type { AuxView, ColumnView } from '../../src/world/store/api';
import { createStore } from '../../src/world/store/store';
import { ask, buildNodeTaskWorker } from './nodeWorker';
import type { RegionAttachMsg, RegionColumnMsg, RegionWorkerReply } from './regionWorker';

/**
 * T1-T5's threaded column scatter and per-column analysis (SP3e spec §5.1 "Extractions", D18), moved out of
 * `test/metrics/terrain.metric.ts` and parameterised: the worker dir, seed, params and columns are arguments, and
 * the part bodies take a population `mode`. terrain.metric.ts calls them in `'enforce'` mode with its own constants
 * (its outputs are unchanged, spec §5.7); the presets' full-tier records call them in `'record'` mode (§5.5).
 * Definitions: terrain.metric.ts' header (SP3b spec §8.2).
 */

/**
 * `'enforce'`: a population below its minimum fails the running metric test softly with "insufficient sample" (SP3b
 * spec §8.1). `'record'`: no minimum is checked; each part's population is returned as `<part>.population`.
 */
export type PopulationMode = 'enforce' | 'record';

export const MIN_PEAK_COLUMNS = 20;
export const MIN_T5_POSITIONS = 1000;
export const MIN_T3_PAIRS = 2000;

const PEAKS = new Set(['windswept_hills', 'snowy_slopes', 'stony_peaks', 'jagged_peaks', 'frozen_peaks'].map((n) => biomeId(n as Parameters<typeof biomeId>[0])));
const T5_LOCAL = [2, 6, 10, 14];
const T3_FAMILY: BiomeFamily = 'lowland';
const FLOAT_MAX_HEIGHT = 6;
const FLOAT_MIN_GAP = 3;

/** Fails the running metric test (soft) when a population is below its minimum. */
export function requireSample(what: string, n: number, min: number): void {
  expect.soft(n, `${what}: insufficient sample (${n} < ${min})`).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(min);
}

/** What the per-column analysis reads of a column: its blocks and aux A (a `ColumnView` is one). */
export interface ScatterColumn {
  sectionBlocks(sy: number): Uint16Array | number;
  aux(): Pick<AuxView, 'worldSurfaceWG' | 'oceanFloorWG' | 'surfaceBiome'> | null;
}

/** Column solidity, index ((y + 64) << 8) | (lz << 4) | lx, from the proto sections. */
function solidity(view: ScatterColumn, out: Uint8Array): Uint8Array {
  for (let sy = 0; sy < 24; sy++) {
    const b = view.sectionBlocks(sy);
    const base = sy << 12;
    if (typeof b === 'number') out.fill(b === AIR ? 0 : 1, base, base + 4096);
    else for (let i = 0; i < 4096; i++) out[base + i] = b[i] === AIR ? 0 : 1;
  }
  return out;
}

/** Solid→air transitions at y ∈ [y0, y1] (y0 ≥ −64) of position p. */
function transitions(solid: Uint8Array, p: number, y0: number, y1: number): number {
  let n = 0;
  for (let y = Math.max(-64, y0); y <= y1; y++) {
    if (solid[((y + 64) << 8) | p] === 1 && (y === 319 || solid[((y + 65) << 8) | p] === 0)) n++;
  }
  return n;
}

/** Voxels of position p in solid runs of height ≤ 6 resting on an air gap of ≥ 3 blocks, at y ∈ [−56, top]. */
function floatingVoxels(solid: Uint8Array, p: number, top: number): number {
  let voxels = 0;
  let gap = 0;
  let run = 0;
  let runGap = 0;
  for (let y = -56; y <= top + 1; y++) {
    const s = y <= 319 && solid[((y + 64) << 8) | p] === 1;
    if (s) {
      if (run === 0) runGap = gap;
      run++;
      gap = 0;
    } else {
      if (run > 0 && run <= FLOAT_MAX_HEIGHT && runGap >= FLOAT_MIN_GAP) voxels += run;
      run = 0;
      gap++;
    }
  }
  return voxels;
}

/** Nearest-rank quantile of a sorted array; NaN for an empty one (a record-mode population of 0). */
const nearestRank = (sorted: ArrayLike<number>, q: number): number =>
  sorted.length === 0 ? NaN : sorted[Math.max(0, Math.ceil(q * sorted.length) - 1)]!;

/** Per-position land flag, floor/top, surface and biome of a 16w × 16h block grid, row-major. */
export interface Grid { n: number; m: number; top: Int16Array; ws: Int16Array; land: Uint8Array; biome: Uint8Array }

export const newGrid = (n: number, m: number): Grid =>
  ({ n, m, top: new Int16Array(n * m), ws: new Int16Array(n * m), land: new Uint8Array(n * m), biome: new Uint8Array(n * m) });

/** Copies one column's aux A into the grid at block offset (ox, oz). */
export function putColumn(g: Grid, a: Pick<AuxView, 'worldSurfaceWG' | 'oceanFloorWG' | 'surfaceBiome'>, ox: number, oz: number): void {
  for (let p = 0; p < 256; p++) {
    const k = (oz + (p >> 4)) * g.n + ox + (p & 15);
    const ws = a.worldSurfaceWG[p]!;
    const of = a.oceanFloorWG[p]!;
    g.ws[k] = ws;
    g.top[k] = of - 1;
    g.land[k] = ws === of ? 1 : 0;
    g.biome[k] = a.surfaceBiome[p]!;
  }
}

/** Water-wall diagnostic over a grid: [wall voxels, water voxels above tops]. */
export function waterWalls(g: Grid): [number, number] {
  let walls = 0;
  let water = 0;
  for (let j = 0; j < g.m; j++) {
    for (let i = 0; i < g.n; i++) {
      const k = j * g.n + i;
      const ws = g.ws[k]!;
      const top = g.top[k]!;
      if (ws - 1 <= top) continue;
      water += ws - 1 - top;
      let minWs = Infinity;
      if (i > 0) minWs = Math.min(minWs, g.ws[k - 1]!);
      if (i < g.n - 1) minWs = Math.min(minWs, g.ws[k + 1]!);
      if (j > 0) minWs = Math.min(minWs, g.ws[k - g.n]!);
      if (j < g.m - 1) minWs = Math.min(minWs, g.ws[k + g.n]!);
      walls += Math.max(0, ws - Math.max(minWs, top + 1));
    }
  }
  return [walls, water];
}

/** The accumulators of one population of scattered columns (order-independent sums). */
export interface Scattered {
  hist: Float64Array; // land tops, index top + 64
  land: number;
  over: number;
  peakLand: number;
  peakOver: number;
  peakColumns: number;
  floatPositions: number;
  floatVoxels: number;
  peakFloatPositions: number;
  t5: number[];
  t5Land: number;
  t5Multi: number;
  /** T3: per biome, inside pairs and their steep count; per same-family biome pair `(min << 8) | max`, the same. */
  inside: Float64Array;
  insideSteep: Float64Array;
  borderPairs: Float64Array;
  borderSteep: Float64Array;
  landPairs: number;
  crossFamilyPairs: number;
  walls: number;
  water: number;
  columns: number;
  waterPositions: number;
  /** Wall time of the population, set by the caller (a timing key: never compared). */
  seconds: number;
}

export const newScattered = (): Scattered => ({
  hist: new Float64Array(384), land: 0, over: 0, peakLand: 0, peakOver: 0, peakColumns: 0,
  floatPositions: 0, floatVoxels: 0, peakFloatPositions: 0, t5: [], t5Land: 0, t5Multi: 0,
  inside: new Float64Array(256), insideSteep: new Float64Array(256),
  borderPairs: new Float64Array(65536), borderSteep: new Float64Array(65536), landPairs: 0, crossFamilyPairs: 0,
  walls: 0, water: 0, columns: 0, waterPositions: 0, seconds: 0,
});

/** Reusable buffers of `analyseColumn` (one per caller thread). */
export interface ScatterScratch { solid: Uint8Array; g: Grid }

export const newScatterScratch = (): ScatterScratch => ({ solid: new Uint8Array(98304), g: newGrid(16, 16) });

/**
 * Adds one generated column (chunk column cx, cz) to `s`: T1's land tops, T2's overhangs and floating rocks, T5's
 * |surfaceEst − true top| at its 16 positions (`surfaceEst(x, z)` is `surfaceEst3` on the population's density
 * context), T3's in-column neighbour pairs and the water-wall diagnostic.
 */
export function analyseColumn(
  s: Scattered,
  view: ScatterColumn,
  cx: number,
  cz: number,
  surfaceEst: (x: number, z: number) => number,
  scratch: ScatterScratch,
): void {
  const { solid, g } = scratch;
  const aux = view.aux()!;
  solidity(view, solid);
  s.columns++;
  let peakHere = false;
  for (let p = 0; p < 256; p++) {
    const ws = aux.worldSurfaceWG[p]!;
    if (ws !== aux.oceanFloorWG[p]!) { s.waterPositions++; continue; }
    const top = ws - 1;
    s.land++;
    s.hist[top + 64]!++;
    const over = transitions(solid, p, top - 30, top) >= 2;
    if (over) s.over++;
    const fv = floatingVoxels(solid, p, top);
    if (fv > 0) { s.floatPositions++; s.floatVoxels += fv; }
    if (PEAKS.has(aux.surfaceBiome[p]!)) {
      s.peakLand++;
      peakHere = true;
      if (over) s.peakOver++;
      if (fv > 0) s.peakFloatPositions++;
    }
  }
  if (peakHere) s.peakColumns++;
  for (const lz of T5_LOCAL) {
    for (const lx of T5_LOCAL) {
      const p = (lz << 4) | lx;
      const ws = aux.worldSurfaceWG[p]!;
      if (ws !== aux.oceanFloorWG[p]!) continue;
      s.t5Land++;
      const top = ws - 1;
      if (transitions(solid, p, -56, top) !== 1) { s.t5Multi++; continue; }
      s.t5.push(Math.abs(surfaceEst(16 * cx + lx, 16 * cz + lz) - top));
    }
  }
  putColumn(g, aux, 0, 0);
  const [wl, wt] = waterWalls(g);
  s.walls += wl;
  s.water += wt;
  const pair = (k: number, q: number): void => {
    if (g.land[k] !== 1 || g.land[q] !== 1) return;
    s.landPairs++;
    const steep = Math.abs(g.top[k]! - g.top[q]!) >= 4 ? 1 : 0;
    const a = g.biome[k]!;
    const b = g.biome[q]!;
    if (a === b) {
      s.inside[a]!++;
      s.insideSteep[a]! += steep;
    } else if (biomeFamily(a) === biomeFamily(b)) {
      const e = a < b ? (a << 8) | b : (b << 8) | a;
      s.borderPairs[e]!++;
      s.borderSteep[e]! += steep;
    } else s.crossFamilyPairs++;
  };
  for (let k = 0; k < 256; k++) {
    if ((k & 15) < 15) pair(k, k + 1);
    if (k < 240) pair(k, k + 16);
  }
}

const scatterScripts = new Map<string, Promise<string>>();
const askRegion = (w: Worker, msg: RegionAttachMsg | RegionColumnMsg): Promise<RegionWorkerReply> => ask<RegionWorkerReply>(w, msg);

/**
 * Generates scattered (possibly repeated) columns up to the T stage on 4 region workers (`regionWorker.ts`, bundled
 * once per `workerDir` under test/.cache/: the dir must be unique per metric file and tier) and calls `visit` on this
 * thread with each column's proto view as soon as it is done, then frees it. Each worker writes into its own small
 * shared store and gets its next column only after `visit` has freed its previous one, so two columns never meet on a
 * store's 64 × 64 torus. `visit` sees the columns in completion order, not the list's: what it accumulates must not
 * depend on the order.
 */
export async function forEachColumnThreaded(
  workerDir: string,
  seed: string,
  params: Params,
  cols: ReadonlyArray<readonly [number, number]>,
  visit: (view: ColumnView, cx: number, cz: number) => void,
): Promise<void> {
  let built = scatterScripts.get(workerDir);
  if (built === undefined) {
    built = buildNodeTaskWorker(workerDir, { entry: 'test/harness/regionWorker.ts' });
    scatterScripts.set(workerDir, built);
  }
  const script = await built;
  const stores = Array.from({ length: 4 }, () => createStore({ shared: true, maxBlockBytes: 8 << 20, maxByteBytes: 8 << 20 }));
  const workers = stores.map(() => new Worker(script));
  try {
    const ready = await Promise.all(workers.map((w, t) => askRegion(w, { type: 'attach', handles: stores[t]!.handles(), seedText: seed, params })));
    for (const r of ready) if (r.type !== 'ready') throw new Error(`region worker: ${r.type === 'error' ? r.message : r.type}`);
    let next = 0;
    const drain = async (t: number): Promise<void> => {
      const store = stores[t]!;
      while (next < cols.length) {
        const [cx, cz] = cols[next++]!;
        const r = await askRegion(workers[t]!, { type: 'column', cx, cz });
        if (r.type !== 'done') throw new Error(`region worker ${t}, column (${cx}, ${cz}): ${r.type === 'error' ? r.message : r.type}`);
        const view = store.proto(cx, cz);
        if (view === null) throw new Error(`region worker ${t}: column (${cx}, ${cz}) has no proto set`);
        visit(view, cx, cz);
        store.freeColumn(cx, cz);
      }
    };
    await Promise.all(workers.map((_, t) => drain(t)));
  } finally {
    await Promise.all(workers.map((w) => w.terminate()));
  }
}

/** Adds `<part>.population` = n for each part (record mode only). */
function populations(rec: Record<string, number>, mode: PopulationMode, parts: readonly string[], n: number): void {
  if (mode === 'record') for (const part of parts) rec[`${part}.population`] = n;
}

/**
 * T1 of one population: the parts `band`, `span`, `above120`, `above200`, then the extras (p5/p50/p95, land
 * positions and share, columns, seconds, water walls). T1 has no minimum; its population is the land positions.
 * `label` names the population in enforce-mode messages (unused: T1 has none; kept for a uniform call).
 */
export function t1Values(s: Scattered, mode: PopulationMode, label: string): Record<string, number> {
  void label;
  const h = s.hist;
  let best = 0;
  for (let b = 0; b + 10 <= 384; b++) {
    let sum = 0;
    for (let k = b; k < b + 10; k++) sum += h[k]!;
    if (sum > best) best = sum;
  }
  const quantile = (q: number): number => {
    const target = Math.ceil(q * s.land);
    let acc = 0;
    for (let k = 0; k < 384; k++) { acc += h[k]!; if (acc >= target) return k - 64; }
    return 319;
  };
  const above = (y: number): number => {
    let sum = 0;
    for (let k = y + 1 + 64; k < 384; k++) sum += h[k]!;
    return sum / s.land;
  };
  const rec: Record<string, number> = {
    band: best / s.land,
    span: quantile(0.95) - quantile(0.05),
    above120: above(120),
    above200: above(200),
    p5: quantile(0.05),
    p50: quantile(0.5),
    p95: quantile(0.95),
    landPositions: s.land,
    landShare: s.land / (256 * s.columns),
    columns: s.columns,
    seconds: s.seconds,
    waterWallVoxels: s.walls,
    waterVoxels: s.water,
    waterWallShare: s.water === 0 ? 0 : s.walls / s.water,
  };
  populations(rec, mode, ['band', 'span', 'above120', 'above200'], s.land);
  return rec;
}

/**
 * T2 of one population: `overhangs` (population: land positions) and `overhangsPeaks` (population: peak columns,
 * minimum 20 in enforce mode), then the floating-rock extras.
 */
export function t2Values(s: Scattered, mode: PopulationMode, label: string): Record<string, number> {
  const rec: Record<string, number> = {
    overhangs: s.over / s.land,
    overhangsPeaks: s.peakLand === 0 ? 0 : s.peakOver / s.peakLand,
    peakPositions: s.peakLand,
    peakColumns: s.peakColumns,
    overhangPositions: s.over,
    floatingRockShare: s.floatPositions / s.land,
    floatingRockVoxels: s.floatVoxels / s.land,
    floatingRockPeaksShare: s.peakLand === 0 ? 0 : s.peakFloatPositions / s.peakLand,
    floatingRockPositions: s.floatPositions,
  };
  if (mode === 'enforce') requireSample(`T2.overhangsPeaks (${label}) peak columns`, s.peakColumns, MIN_PEAK_COLUMNS);
  populations(rec, mode, ['overhangs'], s.land);
  populations(rec, mode, ['overhangsPeaks'], s.peakColumns);
  return rec;
}

/**
 * T3 of one population: `value` over the lowland border pairs (population: those pairs, minimum 2,000 in enforce
 * mode), then per family `familyPairs.<f>` / `familyValue.<f>` and the pair diagnostics.
 */
export function t3Values(s: Scattered, mode: PopulationMode, label: string): Record<string, number> {
  const rec: Record<string, number> = {};
  const fam = new Map<BiomeFamily, [number, number, number]>(); // pairs, steep, expected
  let dropped = 0;
  for (let e = 0; e < 65536; e++) {
    const n = s.borderPairs[e]!;
    if (n === 0) continue;
    const a = e >> 8;
    const b = e & 255;
    if (s.inside[a] === 0 || s.inside[b] === 0) { dropped += n; continue; }
    const d = (s.insideSteep[a]! / s.inside[a]! + s.insideSteep[b]! / s.inside[b]!) / 2;
    const f = fam.get(biomeFamily(a)) ?? [0, 0, 0];
    f[0] += n;
    f[1] += s.borderSteep[e]!;
    f[2] += n * d;
    fam.set(biomeFamily(a), f);
  }
  let all: [number, number, number] = [0, 0, 0];
  for (const [f, [n, st, d]] of fam) {
    rec[`familyPairs.${f}`] = n;
    rec[`familyValue.${f}`] = d === 0 ? Infinity : st / d;
    all = [all[0] + n, all[1] + st, all[2] + d];
  }
  const [n, st, d] = fam.get(T3_FAMILY) ?? [0, 0, 0];
  rec.borderPairs = n;
  rec.borderSteepShare = n === 0 ? 0 : st / n;
  rec.expectedSteepShare = n === 0 ? 0 : d / n;
  rec.allFamiliesValue = all[2] === 0 ? Infinity : all[1] / all[2];
  rec.allFamiliesPairs = all[0];
  rec.droppedPairs = dropped;
  rec.landPairs = s.landPairs;
  rec.crossFamilyPairs = s.crossFamilyPairs;
  rec.columns = s.columns;
  if (mode === 'enforce') requireSample(`T3 (${label}) lowland border pairs`, n, MIN_T3_PAIRS);
  rec.value = d === 0 ? Infinity : st / d;
  populations(rec, mode, ['value'], n);
  return rec;
}

/**
 * T5 of one population: nearest-rank `median`, `p90`, `p99` of |surfaceEst3 − true top| (population: the
 * single-surface positions, minimum 1,000 in enforce mode; NaN when empty), then the extras.
 */
export function t5Values(s: Scattered, mode: PopulationMode, label: string): Record<string, number> {
  const sorted = Float64Array.from(s.t5).sort();
  if (mode === 'enforce') requireSample(`T5 (${label}) single-surface positions`, sorted.length, MIN_T5_POSITIONS);
  const rec: Record<string, number> = {
    median: nearestRank(sorted, 0.5),
    p90: nearestRank(sorted, 0.9),
    p99: nearestRank(sorted, 0.99),
    max: sorted[sorted.length - 1] ?? 0,
    mean: sorted.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / Math.max(1, sorted.length),
    singleSurface: sorted.length,
    landPositions: s.t5Land,
    multiSurface: s.t5Multi,
  };
  populations(rec, mode, ['median', 'p90', 'p99'], sorted.length);
  return rec;
}
```

Create `test/unit/dt2Column.test.ts`:

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { fnv1a32, hash2 } from '../../src/core/hash';
import { resolveProfile } from '../../src/core/params/profiles';
import { Xoshiro128 } from '../../src/core/rng';
import { seedFromInput } from '../../src/core/seed';
import { createGenContext, type GenContext } from '../../src/gen/context';
import { cornerValueIndex } from '../../src/gen/density/compile';
import { createDensityContext } from '../../src/gen/density/context';
import { probe } from '../../src/gen/density/probe';
import { createDensityReference, interpolatedNodes } from '../../src/gen/density/reference';
import { terrainDensityDebug, terrainSurfaceDebug } from '../../src/gen/pipeline/terrainStage';
import { createSurfaceContext, surfaceContextOf } from '../../src/gen/surface/context';
import { surfaceProbe } from '../../src/gen/surface/probe';
import { newSurfaceScan, runAt } from '../../src/gen/surface/scan';
import { fillColumnT } from '../../src/metrics/region';
import { AIR } from '../../src/world/blocks/index';
import { createStore } from '../../src/world/store/store';
import { DT2_VOXELS_PER_COLUMN, dt2Column, dt2Setup, newDt2Acc, type Dt2Acc } from '../harness/dt2';

/**
 * `dt2Column` (SP3e spec §5.1 "Extractions", D18): DT2's per-column checks moved out of `region.metric.ts`. The
 * reference below is the inline loop as `region.metric.ts` ran it before the extraction (SP3b/SP3c's DT2 body for one
 * column, its counters only), run on the same column with a stream in the same state.
 */

interface Inline {
  probeBulk: number; compiledReference: number; surfaceProbeBulk: number; surfaceReference: number;
  voxels: number; maskedVoxels: number; corners: number; surfaceVoxels: number; surfaceExtraVoxels: number;
  surfaceExtraSkipped: number; indices: number[];
}

/** The pre-extraction inline DT2 loop for column (cx, cz), with every context built here. */
function inlineDt2(ctx: GenContext, cx: number, cz: number, r: Xoshiro128): Inline {
  const store = createStore({ shared: false, maxBlockBytes: 4 << 20, maxByteBytes: 4 << 20 });
  const out = new Float64Array(98304);
  const mask = new Uint8Array(98304);
  const masked = new Int32Array(98304);
  const scan = newSurfaceScan();
  const dc = createDensityContext(ctx);
  const ref = createDensityReference(dc.expr, dc.noises);
  const c = dc.compiled;
  const interp = interpolatedNodes(dc.expr).map((n) => ({ inner: n.x, slot: c.interpolatedSlot(n) }));
  const compiled = surfaceContextOf(ctx).compiled;
  const sc = createSurfaceContext(ctx);
  const maxSurfaceDepth = compiled.fastPath!.maxSurfaceDepth;
  const o: Inline = {
    probeBulk: 0, compiledReference: 0, surfaceProbeBulk: 0, surfaceReference: 0, voxels: 0, maskedVoxels: 0,
    corners: 0, surfaceVoxels: 0, surfaceExtraVoxels: 0, surfaceExtraSkipped: 0, indices: [],
  };
  expect(fillColumnT(store, ctx, cx, cz, () => false)).toBe(true);
  const view = store.proto(cx, cz)!;
  terrainDensityDebug(ctx, cx, cz, out, mask);
  let m = 0;
  for (let i = 256; i < 98304; i++) if (mask[i] === 1) masked[m++] = i;
  const s = dc.column(cx, cz);
  terrainSurfaceDebug(ctx, cx, cz, scan);
  const checkSurface = (p: number, y: number): boolean => {
    if (runAt(scan, p, y) < 0) return false;
    o.surfaceVoxels++;
    if (compiled.state(scan, p, y) !== sc.reference.state(scan, sc.settings, p, y)) o.surfaceReference++;
    return true;
  };
  for (let v = 0; v < 16; v++) {
    let i: number;
    if (v >= 11) {
      const p = r.nextInt(256);
      const y = Math.min(319, Math.max(-63, view.aux()!.oceanFloorWG[p]! - 1 + r.nextInt(9) - 4));
      i = ((y + 64) << 8) | p;
    } else {
      i = v >= 6 && m > 0 ? masked[r.nextInt(m)]! : 256 + r.nextInt(98304 - 256);
    }
    o.indices.push(i);
    const lx = i & 15, lz = (i >> 4) & 15, y = (i >> 8) - 64;
    const x = 16 * cx + lx, z = 16 * cz + lz;
    const value = probe(dc, x, y, z);
    const block = view.block(lx, y, lz);
    o.voxels++;
    if ((value > 0) !== (block !== AIR)) o.probeBulk++;
    if (surfaceProbe(sc, x, y, z).state !== block) o.surfaceProbeBulk++;
    checkSurface(i & 255, y);
    if (mask[i] === 1) {
      o.maskedVoxels++;
      if (!Object.is(value, out[i])) o.probeBulk++;
    }
    if (!Object.is(value, ref.voxel(s, x, y, z))) o.compiledReference++;
    const ci = lx >> 2, ck = (y + 64) >> 3, cj = lz >> 2;
    c.cellCorners(ci, ck, cj);
    for (const { inner, slot } of interp) {
      for (let d = 0; d < 8; d++) {
        const ii = ci + (d & 1), kk = ck + ((d >> 2) & 1), jj = cj + ((d >> 1) & 1);
        o.corners++;
        if (!Object.is(c.cornerValues[cornerValueIndex(slot, ii, kk, jj)]!, ref.corner(s, inner, ii, kk, jj))) o.compiledReference++;
      }
    }
  }
  const rSurface = new Xoshiro128(hash2(fnv1a32('DT2.surface'), cx, cz));
  for (let k = 0; k < 8; k++) {
    const p = rSurface.nextInt(256);
    const d = rSurface.nextInt(maxSurfaceDepth + 1);
    const first = scan.runFirst[p]!;
    if (first < scan.runFirst[p + 1]! && checkSurface(p, scan.runTop[first]! - d)) o.surfaceExtraVoxels++;
    else o.surfaceExtraSkipped++;
  }
  return o;
}

const LABEL = "profile default, seed '42'";
const ctxOf = (): GenContext => createGenContext(seedFromInput('42'), resolveProfile('default'));

/** DT2's stream after its first column draw (the metric's first default column at seed '42'), and that column. */
function firstColumn(): { r: Xoshiro128; cx: number; cz: number } {
  const r = new Xoshiro128(fnv1a32('DT2'));
  const cx = -1024 + r.nextInt(2048);
  const cz = -1024 + r.nextInt(2048);
  return { r, cx, cz };
}

const failures = (a: Dt2Acc) => [a.probeBulk, a.compiledReference, a.surfaceProbeBulk, a.surfaceReference];

describe('dt2Column (SP3e spec §5.1, D18)', () => {
  it('on a default column: no failures, the inline loop\'s populations and voxels, the stream advanced by its draws', () => {
    const ctx = ctxOf();
    const a = firstColumn();
    const b = firstColumn();
    expect([a.cx, a.cz]).toEqual([b.cx, b.cz]);
    const inline = inlineDt2(ctx, a.cx, a.cz, a.r);
    const acc = newDt2Acc(LABEL);
    const indices = dt2Column(ctx, b.cx, b.cz, b.r, acc);
    expect(acc.problems).toEqual([]);
    expect(failures(acc)).toEqual([0, 0, 0, 0]);
    expect(failures(acc)).toEqual([inline.probeBulk, inline.compiledReference, inline.surfaceProbeBulk, inline.surfaceReference]);
    expect({
      voxels: acc.voxels, maskedVoxels: acc.maskedVoxels, corners: acc.corners, columns: acc.columns,
      surfaceVoxels: acc.surfaceVoxels, surfaceExtraVoxels: acc.surfaceExtraVoxels, surfaceExtraSkipped: acc.surfaceExtraSkipped,
    }).toEqual({
      voxels: inline.voxels, maskedVoxels: inline.maskedVoxels, corners: inline.corners, columns: 1,
      surfaceVoxels: inline.surfaceVoxels, surfaceExtraVoxels: inline.surfaceExtraVoxels, surfaceExtraSkipped: inline.surfaceExtraSkipped,
    });
    expect(acc.voxels).toBe(DT2_VOXELS_PER_COLUMN);
    expect(acc.maskedVoxels).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(acc.corners).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(indices).toEqual(inline.indices);
    const next = a.r.nextU32();
    expect(b.r.nextU32()).toBe(next);
    expect(next).toBe(PINNED_NEXT);
  });

  it('accumulates over columns: populations add, columns counts calls', () => {
    const ctx = ctxOf();
    const { r, cx, cz } = firstColumn();
    const acc = newDt2Acc(LABEL);
    dt2Column(ctx, cx, cz, r, acc);
    const once = { ...acc, problems: [...acc.problems] };
    const cx2 = -1024 + r.nextInt(2048);
    const cz2 = -1024 + r.nextInt(2048);
    dt2Column(ctx, cx2, cz2, r, acc);
    expect(acc.columns).toBe(2);
    expect(acc.voxels).toBe(2 * DT2_VOXELS_PER_COLUMN);
    expect(acc.corners).toBeGreaterThan(once.corners);
    expect(failures(acc)).toEqual([0, 0, 0, 0]);
  });

  it('an injected mismatch is counted in its own part: a wrong density reference → compiledReference', () => {
    const ctx = ctxOf();
    const setup = dt2Setup(ctx, LABEL);
    const ref = setup.ref;
    setup.ref = { ...ref, voxel: (s, x, y, z, e) => ref.voxel(s, x, y, z, e) + 1 };
    const { r, cx, cz } = firstColumn();
    const acc = newDt2Acc(LABEL);
    dt2Column(ctx, cx, cz, r, acc);
    expect(acc.compiledReference).toBe(DT2_VOXELS_PER_COLUMN);
    expect([acc.probeBulk, acc.surfaceProbeBulk, acc.surfaceReference]).toEqual([0, 0, 0]);
    expect(acc.problems).toHaveLength(DT2_VOXELS_PER_COLUMN);
    expect(acc.problems[0]).toMatch(new RegExp(`^profile default, seed '42', column \\(${cx}, ${cz}\\): \\(-?\\d+, -?\\d+, -?\\d+\\) compiled .* ≠ reference `));

    setup.ref = { ...ref, corner: (s, e, i, k, j) => ref.corner(s, e, i, k, j) - 1 };
    const acc2 = newDt2Acc(LABEL);
    dt2Column(ctx, cx, cz, new Xoshiro128(7), acc2);
    expect(acc2.corners).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(acc2.compiledReference).toBe(acc2.corners);
    expect([acc2.probeBulk, acc2.surfaceProbeBulk, acc2.surfaceReference]).toEqual([0, 0, 0]);
    expect(acc2.problems[0]).toMatch(/: corner \(\d+, \d+, \d+\) compiled .* ≠ reference /);
  });

  it('an injected mismatch is counted in its own part: a wrong surface reference → surfaceReference', () => {
    const ctx = ctxOf();
    const setup = dt2Setup(ctx, LABEL);
    const sc = setup.sc;
    setup.sc = { ...sc, reference: { ...sc.reference, state: () => 65535 } };
    const { r, cx, cz } = firstColumn();
    const acc = newDt2Acc(LABEL);
    dt2Column(ctx, cx, cz, r, acc);
    expect(acc.surfaceVoxels).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(acc.surfaceReference).toBe(acc.surfaceVoxels);
    expect([acc.probeBulk, acc.compiledReference, acc.surfaceProbeBulk]).toEqual([0, 0, 0]);
    expect(acc.problems.every((t) => t.includes('compiled state') && t.endsWith('≠ reference 65535'))).toBe(true);
  });

  it('dt2Setup is memoised per GenContext and refuses a rule tree without a fast path with the label', () => {
    const ctx = ctxOf();
    expect(dt2Setup(ctx, LABEL)).toBe(dt2Setup(ctx, 'other'));
    expect(dt2Setup(ctx, LABEL).maxSurfaceDepth).toBe(surfaceContextOf(ctx).compiled.fastPath!.maxSurfaceDepth);
    const ctx2 = ctxOf();
    const sc = surfaceContextOf(ctx2);
    Object.defineProperty(sc, 'compiled', { value: { ...sc.compiled, fastPath: null } });
    expect(() => dt2Setup(ctx2, LABEL)).toThrow(`DT2: ${LABEL}: the default tree has no fast path`);
  });
});

/** The DT2 stream's next u32 after the metric's first default column (seed '42') and its 16 voxels. */
const PINNED_NEXT = 3754532636;
```
