```bash
cp "$TUNING/tools/m-slices.test.ts" test/unit/
M_OUT="$TUNING/before/slices" npx vitest run --project unit test/unit/m-slices.test.ts
rm test/unit/m-slices.test.ts
```

It writes `<preset>/slice-*.png` and `slices.json` (floating_islands also a 3 px/block zoom, `slice-islands-cluster-zoom.png`). The dry run's slice summaries (512 blocks): archipelago-coast land 508 / sea 4, tops 61-134 (the line is almost all land, see above); amplified-mountain land 512, tops 173-302 (before the fades), 51 overhang positions; islands-cluster land 57 / sea 455, tops 23-251, waterUnderStone 1,772 (the sea under the islands, D5).

- [ ] **Step 3: The core's break-up and the footprint image (diagnostic)**

Save this probe as `$TUNING/tools/m-probe.test.ts` (test B is the break-up; A, C, D and F were the dry run's other questions, kept for reference):

```ts
// Checkpoint M throwaway probe (not committed). Copy into <worktree>/test/unit/, run with vitest --project unit, delete.
// A: Z1's quick columns (seed '42', fnv1a32('Z1'), 256 in ±1024 chunks) — which columns give land tops ≥ 290.
// B: the floating_islands window (seed '42'): 3D 6-connected components of island-run voxels (bottom ≥ 181).
// C: archipelago: the window an on-line predicate would give (centre and (128a ± 60, 128b) both sea and land).
import { test } from 'vitest';
import { ISLAND_RUN_MIN_BOTTOM } from '../../src/core/constants';
import { fnv1a32 } from '../../src/core/hash';
import { resolveProfile } from '../../src/core/params/profiles';
import { Xoshiro128 } from '../../src/core/rng';
import { seedFromInput } from '../../src/core/seed';
import { createGenContext } from '../../src/gen/context';
import { columnPoint } from '../../src/gen/column/columnPoint';
import { fillColumnT } from '../../src/metrics/region';
import { findWindow, presetWindow } from '../../src/metrics/sp3eGoldens';
import { createStore } from '../../src/world/store/store';
import { columnStates, islandRuns, positionColumn, landComponents } from '../harness/zMetrics';
import { encodePng } from '../harness/png';
import { writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { islandMaskAt } from '../../src/gen/column/islands';

const MODE = process.env.M_PROBE ?? 'ABC';
const store = createStore({ shared: false, maxBlockBytes: 64 << 20, maxByteBytes: 32 << 20 });
const never = (): boolean => false;
const states = new Uint16Array(384 << 8);
const col = new Uint8Array(384);

test('A: Z1 tall columns', () => {
  if (!MODE.includes('A')) return;
  const ctx = createGenContext(seedFromInput('42'), resolveProfile('amplified'));
  const r = new Xoshiro128(fnv1a32('Z1'));
  const rows: string[] = [];
  for (let n = 0; n < 256; n++) {
    const cx = -1024 + r.nextInt(2048), cz = -1024 + r.nextInt(2048);
    fillColumnT(store, ctx, cx, cz, never);
    const v = store.proto(cx, cz)!;
    const aux = v.aux()!;
    let n290 = 0, n300 = 0, lo = 999, hi = -999;
    for (let p = 0; p < 256; p++) {
      const ws = aux.worldSurfaceWG[p]!;
      if (ws !== aux.oceanFloorWG[p]!) continue;
      const t = ws - 1;
      if (t >= 290) { n290++; lo = Math.min(lo, t); hi = Math.max(hi, t); }
      if (t >= 300) n300++;
    }
    if (n290 > 0) {
      const c = columnPoint(ctx, 16 * cx + 8, 16 * cz + 8);
      rows.push(`col #${n} (${cx}, ${cz}) block (${16 * cx + 8}, ${16 * cz + 8}): tops>=290 ${n290}, >=300 ${n300}, range ${lo}-${hi}, offset0 ${c.offset0.toFixed(1)} offset ${c.offset.toFixed(1)} jag ${c.jag.toFixed(1)} sigma ${c.sigma.toFixed(1)}`);
    }
    store.freeColumn(cx, cz);
  }
  console.log(`A:\n${rows.join('\n')}`);
}, 600_000);

test('B: 3D island components in the floating window', () => {
  if (!MODE.includes('B')) return;
  const ctx = createGenContext(seedFromInput('42'), resolveProfile('floating_islands'));
  const w = presetWindow('floating_islands');
  const Y0 = ISLAND_RUN_MIN_BOTTOM, H = 320 - Y0, N = 128;
  const vox = new Uint8Array(N * N * H);
  for (let dz = 0; dz < 8; dz++) for (let dx = 0; dx < 8; dx++) {
    const cx = w.chunkX + dx, cz = w.chunkZ + dz;
    fillColumnT(store, ctx, cx, cz, never);
    columnStates(store.proto(cx, cz)!, states);
    for (let p = 0; p < 256; p++) {
      positionColumn(states, p, col);
      const x = 16 * dx + (p & 15), z = 16 * dz + (p >> 4);
      for (const run of islandRuns(col, Y0)) for (let y = run.bottom; y <= run.top; y++) vox[((y - Y0) * N + z) * N + x] = 1;
    }
    store.freeColumn(cx, cz);
  }
  const parent = new Int32Array(vox.length).fill(-1);
  const find = (i: number): number => { while (parent[i] !== i) { parent[i] = parent[parent[i]!]!; i = parent[i]!; } return i; };
  const union = (a: number, b: number): void => { const ra = find(a), rb = find(b); if (ra !== rb) parent[ra] = rb; };
  for (let i = 0; i < vox.length; i++) if (vox[i]) parent[i] = i;
  for (let y = 0; y < H; y++) for (let z = 0; z < N; z++) for (let x = 0; x < N; x++) {
    const i = (y * N + z) * N + x;
    if (!vox[i]) continue;
    if (x > 0 && vox[i - 1]) union(i, i - 1);
    if (z > 0 && vox[i - N]) union(i, i - N);
    if (y > 0 && vox[i - N * N]) union(i, i - N * N);
  }
  const size = new Map<number, number>();
  let total = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < vox.length; i++) if (vox[i]) { total++; const r = find(i); size.set(r, (size.get(r) ?? 0) + 1); }
  const sizes = [...size.values()].sort((a, b) => b - a);
  const big = sizes.filter((s) => s >= 1000).length;
  const foot = new Uint8Array(N * N);
  for (let i = 0; i < vox.length; i++) if (vox[i]) foot[i % (N * N)] = 1;
  const c2 = landComponents(foot, N, 4);
  let lf = 0; for (let id = 1; id <= c2.count; id++) lf = Math.max(lf, c2.size[id]!);
  if (process.env.M_OUT !== undefined) {
    // E: the window's footprint, 4 px per block: each island position coloured by the 3D component of its highest
    // island voxel (the 6 largest get distinct colours, the rest white), over the ground (land green, sea blue).
    const rank = new Map<number, number>();
    [...size.entries()].sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).forEach(([r], i) => rank.set(r, i));
    const PAL = [[230, 60, 60], [250, 170, 30], [240, 240, 60], [70, 200, 90], [200, 90, 230], [60, 200, 230]];
    const K = 4, img = new Uint8Array(4 * N * K * N * K);
    for (let z = 0; z < N; z++) for (let x = 0; x < N; x++) {
      let c = columnPoint(ctx, 16 * w.chunkX + x, 16 * w.chunkZ + z).offset0 >= 63 ? [70, 110, 60] : [30, 50, 110];
      for (let y = H - 1; y >= 0; y--) { const i = (y * N + z) * N + x; if (vox[i]) { c = PAL[rank.get(find(i))!] ?? [245, 245, 245]; break; } }
      if (c[0] === 30 || c[0] === 70) { const m = islandMaskAt(ctx, 16 * w.chunkX + x, 16 * w.chunkZ + z); if (m > 0) c = c.map((v) => Math.round(v + 40 * m)); }
      for (let dy = 0; dy < K; dy++) for (let dx = 0; dx < K; dx++) { const o = 4 * ((z * K + dy) * N * K + x * K + dx); img[o] = c[0]!; img[o + 1] = c[1]!; img[o + 2] = c[2]!; img[o + 3] = 255; }
    }
    writeFileSync(join(process.env.M_OUT, 'footprint-floating-window.png'), encodePng({ width: N * K, height: N * K, rgba: img }));
  }
  console.log(`B: window ${JSON.stringify(w)} island voxels ${total}; 3D components ${sizes.length} (≥1000 voxels: ${big}); largest ${sizes.slice(0, 6).join(', ')} → largest share ${(sizes[0]! / total).toFixed(3)}; footprint ${foot.reduce((a, v) => a + v, 0)} positions (${(foot.reduce((a, v) => a + v, 0) / (N * N)).toFixed(3)}), 2D comps ${c2.count}, largest footprint ${(lf / (N * N)).toFixed(3)}`);
}, 600_000);

test('C: archipelago on-line window', () => {
  if (!MODE.includes('C')) return;
  const ctx = createGenContext(seedFromInput('42'), resolveProfile('archipelago'));
  const sea = (x: number, z: number): boolean => columnPoint(ctx, x, z).offset0 < 63;
  const w1 = findWindow('archipelago', (a, b) => {
    const s = [sea(128 * a, 128 * b), sea(128 * a - 60, 128 * b), sea(128 * a + 60, 128 * b)];
    return s.includes(true) && s.includes(false);
  });
  // stronger: 33 points across the 512-block line (x − 256 … x + 256 step 16): sea share in [0.25, 0.75]
  const w2 = findWindow('archipelago', (a, b) => {
    let s = 0; for (let k = -16; k <= 16; k++) if (sea(128 * a + 16 * k, 128 * b)) s++;
    return s >= 9 && s <= 24;
  });
  const old = presetWindow('archipelago');
  const share = (w: { centreX: number; centreZ: number }): number => { let s = 0; for (let x = w.centreX - 256; x < w.centreX + 256; x++) if (sea(x, w.centreZ)) s++; return s / 512; };
  console.log(`C: current ${JSON.stringify(old)} line sea share ${share(old).toFixed(3)}; on-line ±60 ${JSON.stringify(w1)} sea ${share(w1).toFixed(3)}; 33-point [9, 24] ${JSON.stringify(w2)} sea ${share(w2).toFixed(3)}`);
}, 600_000);

test('D: a floating_islands cluster over land (for the D21 shot)', () => {
  if (!MODE.includes('D')) return;
  const ctx = createGenContext(seedFromInput('42'), resolveProfile('floating_islands'));
  const w = findWindow('floating_islands-land', (a, b) => {
    const c = columnPoint(ctx, 128 * a, 128 * b);
    return c.islandMask >= 0.9 && c.offset0 >= 70 && c.offset0 <= 110;
  });
  console.log(`D: land cluster window ${JSON.stringify(w)}`);
}, 600_000);

test('F: extra solid runs per position on the terrain.islands bench columns (D21 (b) cost estimate)', () => {
  if (!MODE.includes('F')) return;
  const params = resolveProfile('floating_islands');
  const ctx = createGenContext(seedFromInput('42'), params);
  const probe = createGenContext(seedFromInput('42'), params);
  const cols: Array<[number, number]> = [];
  for (let t = 1; cols.length < 256; t++) {
    const x = (t * 7919) % 60000 - 30000, z = (t * 104729) % 60000 - 30000;
    if (columnPoint(probe, 16 * x + 8, 16 * z + 8).islandMask >= 0.5) cols.push([x, z]);
  }
  let positions = 0, runs = 0, multi = 0, islandPos = 0, colsWithIsland = 0;
  const perCol: number[] = [];
  for (const [x, z] of cols) {
    fillColumnT(store, ctx, x, z, never);
    columnStates(store.proto(x, z)!, states);
    let extra = 0, isl = 0;
    for (let p = 0; p < 256; p++) {
      positionColumn(states, p, col);
      let n = 0, prev = 0;
      for (let i = 0; i < 384; i++) { const s = col[i] !== 0 ? 1 : 0; if (s && !prev) n++; prev = s; }
      positions++; runs += n; if (n > 1) { multi++; extra += n - 1; }
      if (islandRuns(col, ISLAND_RUN_MIN_BOTTOM).length > 0) { islandPos++; isl++; }
    }
    if (isl > 0) colsWithIsland++;
    perCol.push(extra);
    store.freeColumn(x, z);
  }
  perCol.sort((a, b) => a - b);
  console.log(`F: ${cols.length} bench columns: runs/position ${(runs / positions).toFixed(3)}, positions with ≥ 2 runs ${(multi / positions).toFixed(3)}, island positions ${(islandPos / positions).toFixed(3)}, columns holding an island ${colsWithIsland}; extra runs per column p50 ${perCol[128]} p90 ${perCol[230]} max ${perCol[255]}`);
}, 600_000);
```

- [ ] **Step 4: The Voxels and map shots**

Save this tool as `$TUNING/tools/m-shots.ts`. It starts its own `vite preview` on a free port (never 5183) and its own headless Chrome (`/usr/bin/google-chrome`; change the path if yours differs) with the profile directory you give it, and stops exactly those two processes by their PIDs:

```ts
/**
 * Checkpoint M throwaway shot tool (not committed). Copy into <worktree>/test/tools/ and run from the worktree after
 * `npm run build`:  node test/tools/m-shots.ts --out DIR --profile-dir $(mktemp -d /tmp/wi10-XXXX) [--lines JSON]
 * It starts its own `vite preview` (free port, never 5183) and its own headless Chrome, and stops exactly those two
 * children (by their PIDs) at the end. Shots (SP3e spec §8, §1.5 step 1):
 * - preset-<p>.png: the cross-section's Voxels mode on each preset's 1,024-block line (centred on its window centre);
 *   floating_islands' with the pointer on the ground top under an island (D21's shadow) and its readout;
 * - preset-archipelago-map.png (biome) and preset-floating_islands-islandMask.png: 4096² blocks at 16 blocks/px.
 * --lines '{"amplified":[x,z],...}' overrides the line centres (default: the Task 16 windows of seed '42').
 */
import { spawn, type ChildProcess } from 'node:child_process';
import { existsSync, mkdirSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { createServer } from 'node:net';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { mapHash, parseSegment, SKY_RGB, sliceCellPoint, VIEWPORT, type MapUrlState } from './uiSmoke.ts';

const ROOT = fileURLToPath(new URL('../../', import.meta.url));
const arg = (k: string): string | null => { const i = process.argv.indexOf(k); return i < 0 ? null : process.argv[i + 1] ?? null; };
const OUT = arg('--out');
const PROFILE = arg('--profile-dir');
if (OUT === null || PROFILE === null) throw new Error('--out and --profile-dir are required');
const LINES: Record<string, [number, number]> = { archipelago: [-256, 256], amplified: [-640, 0], floating_islands: [-768, -1408], 'floating_islands-land': [256, 384], ...(JSON.parse(arg('--lines') ?? '{}') as Record<string, [number, number]>) };
const ONLY = (arg('--only') ?? 'archipelago,amplified,floating_islands,floating_islands-land,maps').split(',');
const sleep = (ms: number) => new Promise<void>((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));
const kids: ChildProcess[] = [];
const run = (cmd: string, args: string[], opts: object): ChildProcess => { const c = spawn(cmd, args, opts); kids.push(c); console.log(`started ${cmd.split('/').pop()} pid ${c.pid}`); return c; };

async function freePort(): Promise<number> {
  for (;;) {
    const p = await new Promise<number>((res, rej) => { const s = createServer(); s.once('error', rej); s.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', () => { const a = s.address(); const n = typeof a === 'object' && a !== null ? a.port : 0; s.close(() => res(n)); }); });
    if (p !== 0 && p !== 5183) return p;
  }
}

type Send = (method: string, params?: Record<string, unknown>) => Promise<Record<string, unknown>>;
async function connect(url: string): Promise<{ send: Send; close: () => void }> {
  const ws = new WebSocket(url);
  await new Promise<void>((res, rej) => { ws.addEventListener('open', () => res(), { once: true }); ws.addEventListener('error', () => rej(new Error('ws')), { once: true }); });
  let id = 0;
  const pending = new Map<number, { res: (v: Record<string, unknown>) => void; rej: (e: Error) => void }>();
  ws.addEventListener('message', (ev) => {
    const m = JSON.parse(String(ev.data)) as { id?: number; result?: Record<string, unknown>; error?: { message: string } };
    if (m.id === undefined) return;
    const p = pending.get(m.id); pending.delete(m.id);
    if (m.error) p?.rej(new Error(m.error.message)); else p?.res(m.result ?? {});
  });
  return { send: (method, params = {}) => new Promise((res, rej) => { const i = ++id; pending.set(i, { res, rej }); ws.send(JSON.stringify({ id: i, method, params })); }), close: () => ws.close() };
}

async function main(): Promise<void> {
  mkdirSync(OUT!, { recursive: true });
  const port = await freePort();
  const base = `http://127.0.0.1:${port}/`;
  const preview = run(process.execPath, [join(ROOT, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'preview', '--host', '127.0.0.1', '--port', String(port), '--strictPort'], { cwd: ROOT, stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'] });
  await new Promise<void>((res, rej) => { let out = ''; const t = setTimeout(() => rej(new Error('preview')), 30000); preview.stdout!.on('data', (d: Buffer) => { out += d.toString(); if (out.replace(/\x1b\[[0-9;]*m/g, '').includes(base)) { clearTimeout(t); res(); } }); });
  const chrome = run('/usr/bin/google-chrome', ['--headless=new', `--user-data-dir=${PROFILE}`, '--remote-debugging-port=0', '--no-first-run', '--no-default-browser-check',
    '--disable-background-timer-throttling', '--disable-backgrounding-occluded-windows', '--disable-renderer-backgrounding', `--window-size=${VIEWPORT.width},${VIEWPORT.height}`, 'about:blank'], { stdio: 'ignore' });
  let dport = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < 150 && dport === 0; i++) { const f = join(PROFILE!, 'DevToolsActivePort'); if (existsSync(f)) dport = Number(readFileSync(f, 'utf8').split('\n')[0]); else await sleep(100); }
  const targets = await (await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:${dport}/json/list`)).json() as Array<{ type: string; webSocketDebuggerUrl: string }>;
  const cdp = await connect(targets.find((t) => t.type === 'page')!.webSocketDebuggerUrl);
  const errors: string[] = [];
  try {
    await cdp.send('Runtime.enable'); await cdp.send('Page.enable');
    await cdp.send('Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride', { width: VIEWPORT.width, height: VIEWPORT.height, deviceScaleFactor: 1, mobile: false });
    const ev = async <T>(expression: string): Promise<T> => {
      const r = await cdp.send('Runtime.evaluate', { expression, awaitPromise: true, returnByValue: true });
      if (r['exceptionDetails'] !== undefined) throw new Error(`page: ${JSON.stringify(r['exceptionDetails']).slice(0, 300)}`);
      return (r['result'] as { value?: unknown }).value as T;
    };
    const until = async (pred: string, what: string, ms = 60000): Promise<void> => {
      const t0 = Date.now();
      while (Date.now() - t0 < ms) { if (await ev<boolean>(`(() => { try { return !!(${pred}); } catch { return false; } })()`)) return; await sleep(100); }
      throw new Error(`no ${what} within ${ms} ms`);
    };
    const SETTLED = `(() => { const s = document.querySelector('.map-status')?.textContent ?? ''; return /preview \\d+ ms/.test(s) && !s.includes('pending') && !s.includes('error'); })()`;
    const goto = async (s: MapUrlState) => {
      await cdp.send('Page.navigate', { url: 'about:blank' }); await sleep(200);
      await cdp.send('Page.navigate', { url: `${base}?map#${mapHash(s)}` });
      await until(`document.readyState === 'complete' && ${SETTLED}`, 'settled map');
    };
    const box = (sel: string) => ev<{ x: number; y: number; width: number; height: number }>(`(() => { const r = document.querySelector(${JSON.stringify(sel)}).getBoundingClientRect(); return { x: r.left, y: r.top, width: r.width, height: r.height }; })()`);
    const mouse = (type: string, x: number, y: number) => cdp.send('Input.dispatchMouseEvent', { type, x, y, button: type === 'mouseMoved' ? 'none' : 'left', buttons: type === 'mousePressed' ? 1 : 0, clickCount: type === 'mouseMoved' ? 0 : 1 });
    const clickAt = async (x: number, y: number) => { await mouse('mouseMoved', x, y); await mouse('mousePressed', x, y); await mouse('mouseReleased', x, y); };
    const click = async (sel: string) => { const b = await box(sel); await clickAt(b.x + b.width / 2, b.y + b.height / 2); };
    const shot = async (name: string, clip?: { x: number; y: number; width: number; height: number }) => {
      const r = await cdp.send('Page.captureScreenshot', { format: 'png', ...(clip ? { clip: { ...clip, scale: 1 } } : {}) });
      writeFileSync(join(OUT!, name), Buffer.from(String(r['data']), 'base64'));
      console.log(`wrote ${join(OUT!, name)}`);
    };
    const report: Record<string, unknown> = {};
    for (const name of ['archipelago', 'amplified', 'floating_islands', 'floating_islands-land']) {
      if (!ONLY.includes(name)) continue;
      const p = name.startsWith('floating_islands') ? 'floating_islands' : name;
      const [x, z] = LINES[name]!;
      await goto({ v: 1, seed: '42', profile: p, patch: {}, view: { x, z, bpp: 2, layer: 'relief' } });
      await click('#map-tab-world');
      await click('.map-cut');
      const mc = await box('.map-canvas');
      const cx = mc.x + mc.width / 2, cy = mc.y + mc.height / 2;
      await clickAt(cx - 256, cy); await clickAt(cx + 256, cy);
      await until(`document.querySelector('.cs').dataset.state === 'fresh'`, 'fresh cross-section');
      const line = await ev<string>(`document.querySelector('.cs-line').textContent`);
      const seg = parseSegment(line);
      await click('.cs-mode[data-mode="voxels"]');
      await until(`document.querySelector('.cs').dataset.mode === 'voxels' && document.querySelector('.cs').dataset.state === 'fresh'`, 'fresh voxel slice');
      // the drawer dragged to its tallest, as uiSmoke's density shots, so the 384-row slice is readable
      const sp = await box('.map-split-h');
      await mouse('mouseMoved', sp.x + sp.width / 2, sp.y + sp.height / 2);
      await cdp.send('Input.dispatchMouseEvent', { type: 'mousePressed', x: sp.x + sp.width / 2, y: sp.y + sp.height / 2, button: 'left', buttons: 1, clickCount: 1 });
      for (let k = 1; k <= 25; k++) { await cdp.send('Input.dispatchMouseEvent', { type: 'mouseMoved', x: sp.x + sp.width / 2, y: sp.y + sp.height / 2 - 15 * k, button: 'left', buttons: 1 }); await sleep(16); }
      await cdp.send('Input.dispatchMouseEvent', { type: 'mouseReleased', x: sp.x + sp.width / 2, y: sp.y + sp.height / 2 - 375, button: 'left', buttons: 0, clickCount: 1 });
      await sleep(800);
      const summary = await ev<string>(`document.querySelector('.cs-summary').textContent`);
      const entry: Record<string, unknown> = { line, seg, summary };
      if (p === 'floating_islands') {
        // the sample with the island nearest the line's middle: walk down past the island and the water to the ground top
        const cols = await ev<number[][]>(`(() => { const c = document.querySelector('.cs-voxels'); const g = c.getContext('2d'); const out = []; for (let i = 0; i < 512; i++) out.push(Array.from(g.getImageData(i, 0, 1, 384).data)); return out; })()`);
        const sky = (d: number[], r: number) => d[4 * r] === SKY_RGB[0] && d[4 * r + 1] === SKY_RGB[1] && d[4 * r + 2] === SKY_RGB[2];
        const water = (d: number[], r: number) => d[4 * r + 2]! > d[4 * r]! + 40 && d[4 * r + 2]! > d[4 * r + 1]! + 10;
        let pick: { i: number; row: number } | null = null;
        const order = [...Array(512).keys()].sort((a, b) => Math.abs(a - 256) - Math.abs(b - 256));
        for (const i of order) {
          const d = cols[i]!;
          let r = 0;
          while (r < 384 && sky(d, r)) r++;
          if (r >= 319 - 181) continue; // no island run above y 181 at this sample
          while (r < 384 && !sky(d, r)) r++; // through the island
          while (r < 384 && (sky(d, r) || water(d, r))) r++; // the air and the water under it
          if (r < 384) { pick = { i, row: r }; break; }
        }
        if (pick !== null) {
          const vb = await box('.cs-voxels');
          await mouse('mouseMoved', ...sliceCellPoint(vb, pick.i, pick.row));
          await sleep(600);
          await until(`/ · rule root\\S*$/.test(document.querySelector('.cs-readout').textContent)`, 'the hover rule id', 10000).catch(() => undefined);
          entry['hover'] = { sample: pick.i, row: pick.row, y: 319 - pick.row, readout: await ev<string>(`document.querySelector('.cs-readout').textContent`) };
        }
      }
      await sleep(800);
      await shot(`preset-${name}.png`);
      report[name] = entry;
      console.log(name, JSON.stringify(entry));
    }
    if (ONLY.includes('maps')) {
      for (const [p, layer, name] of [['archipelago', 'biome', 'preset-archipelago-map.png'], ['floating_islands', 'islandMask', 'preset-floating_islands-islandMask.png']] as const) {
        const [x, z] = LINES[p]!;
        await goto({ v: 1, seed: '42', profile: p, patch: {}, view: { x, z, bpp: 16, layer } });
        await sleep(1500);
        await until(SETTLED, 'settled tiles');
        const mc = await box('.map-canvas');
        await shot(name, { x: Math.round(mc.x + mc.width / 2) - 128, y: Math.round(mc.y + mc.height / 2) - 128, width: 256, height: 256 });
      }
    }
    writeFileSync(join(OUT!, 'shots.json'), `${JSON.stringify(report, null, 2)}\n`);
  } finally {
    cdp.close();
    for (const c of kids.reverse()) {
      if (c.exitCode !== null || c.signalCode !== null) continue;
      const done = new Promise<void>((r) => c.once('exit', () => r()));
      c.kill('SIGTERM');
      if (!(await Promise.race([done.then(() => true), sleep(5000).then(() => false)]))) { c.kill('SIGKILL'); await done; }
      console.log(`stopped pid ${c.pid}`);
    }
    if (errors.length) console.log(errors);
  }
}
main().catch((e: unknown) => { console.error(e); process.exitCode = 1; });
```

```diff
+    const off = withFlag(FLOATING, false);
+    const world = createGenContext(seed, DEFAULTS);
+    const probeSc = createSurfaceContext(off);
+    let solidity = 0, fluid = 0, changed = 0, columns = 0, outside = 0;
+    for (const [cx, cz] of WINDOW) {
+      const a = generate(off, cx, cz), b = generate(world, cx, cz);
+      let here = 0;
+      let scan: SurfaceScan | null = null;
+      for (let p = 0; p < 256; p++) {
+        for (let y = -63; y <= 319; y++) {
+          const i = at(p, y);
+          if ((a.blocks[i] === AIR) !== (b.blocks[i] === AIR)) solidity++;
+          if (a.fluid[i] !== b.fluid[i]) fluid++;
+          if (a.blocks[i] === b.blocks[i]) continue;
+          here++;
+          scan ??= surfaceProbeColumn(probeSc, cx, cz).scan;
+          // §4.1's predicate: a run topped at y ≥ 181, the voxel within 100 blocks of the run's bottom.
+          const r = runOf(scan, p, y);
+          if (r < 0 || scan.runTop[r]! < ISLAND_RUN_MIN_BOTTOM || y - scan.runBottom[r]! > 100) outside++;
+        }
+      }
+      changed += here;
+      if (here > 0) columns++;
+    }
+    // Unticking the flag removes the islands (the mask is 0, so the term's gate gives −1e6) and their water rule, not
+    // the preset's rules: 47 of the 64 columns keep the islands palette on their peaks (mostly stone → dirt or grass).
+    expect({ solidity, fluid, outside, changed, columns }).toEqual({ solidity: 0, fluid: 0, outside: 0, changed: 23585, columns: 47 });
+  }, 120_000);
+
+  test.each([['default', 5953, 1373, 34, 0], ['amplified', 4144, 783, 26, 543]] as const)('%s with the flag on: the same solidity and water; states change only where a run lies above y 180, stage == reference == compiled.state there', (id, wantVoxels, wantPositions, wantColumns, wantSnowToStone) => {
+    const params = resolveProfile(id);
+    const on = withFlag(params, true), off = withFlag(params, false);
+    const probeSc = createSurfaceContext(on);
+    let solidity = 0, fluid = 0, voxels = 0, positions = 0, columns = 0, noIslandRun = 0, checked = 0, snowToStone = 0;
+    const SNOW = REGISTRY.parseStateKey('snow_block');
+    for (const [cx, cz] of WINDOW) {
+      const a = generate(on, cx, cz), b = generate(off, cx, cz);
+      let here = 0;
+      let c: ReturnType<typeof surfaceProbeColumn> | null = null;
+      for (let p = 0; p < 256; p++) {
+        let at_p = 0;
+        for (let y = -63; y <= 319; y++) {
+          const i = at(p, y);
+          if ((a.blocks[i] === AIR) !== (b.blocks[i] === AIR)) solidity++;
+          if (a.fluid[i] !== b.fluid[i]) fluid++;
+          if (a.blocks[i] !== b.blocks[i]) {
+            at_p++;
+            if (b.blocks[i] === SNOW && a.blocks[i] === STONE) snowToStone++;
+          }
+        }
+        if (at_p === 0) continue;
+        voxels += at_p; here += at_p; positions++;
+        c ??= surfaceProbeColumn(probeSc, cx, cz);
+        let islandRun = false;
+        for (let r = c.scan.runFirst[p]!; r < c.scan.runFirst[p + 1]!; r++) if (c.scan.runBottom[r]! >= ISLAND_RUN_MIN_BOTTOM) islandRun = true;
+        if (!islandRun) noIslandRun++;
+        expect(c.scan.skyRun[p], `(${cx}, ${cz}) p ${p}`).not.toBe(c.scan.runFirst[p]);
+        // The default rules are sky-gated: their fast path must follow the flag's sky-open run.
+        for (let y = -63; y <= 319; y++) {
+          const i = at(p, y);
+          if (a.blocks[i] === AIR) continue;
+          const ref = probeSc.reference.state(c.scan, probeSc.settings, p, y);
+          expect(a.blocks[i], `(${cx}, ${cz}) p ${p} y ${y} stage ≠ reference`).toBe(ref);
+          expect(probeSc.compiled.state(c.scan, p, y), `(${cx}, ${cz}) p ${p} y ${y}`).toBe(ref);
+          checked++;
+        }
+      }
+      if (here > 0) columns++;
+    }
+    expect({ solidity, fluid, noIslandRun }).toEqual({ solidity: 0, fluid: 0, noIslandRun: 0 });
+    expect(checked).toBeGreaterThan(positions * 100);
+    // A detached peak above y 180 is no longer the sky-open run: its top loses the sky-open palette (snow → stone).
+    expect({ id, voxels, positions, columns, snowToStone }).toEqual({ id, voxels: wantVoxels, positions: wantPositions, columns: wantColumns, snowToStone: wantSnowToStone });
+  }, 120_000);
+});
```

```bash
reference == compiled.state. The default rules (sky-gated) with the flag
```

The user chose D21 (b) at Checkpoint M, and Task 7 was built, so this task is built. Review Focus item 2 is tested here ("floating_islands with the flag off: the default world's solidity and water; its rules still give runs topped above y 180 the islands palette", the flag on default and amplified, the sky-gated default rules with the flag), and `islands.enabled`'s doc says the flag switches no tree. The spec on `main` already reads D21 (b) as built, so this commit does not edit it.

From the dry run's "Task 18":

- Built on dry/sp3e (parent Task 17; worktree P/dry). Built per the user's D21 (b) at Checkpoint M (Task 7 was built). RED over the parent (the 3 touched test files copied into a throwaway detached worktree P/plan/red18 at Task 17, removed after): 16 failed / 37 passed — floatingRules.test.ts 14 (root.rules[1] is 'condition' not 'sequence'; minY path undefined; 180 nodes ≠ 181; skyGated true ≠ false; settings.islandRuns undefined; the constructed cases: the ground under an island is band stone, e.g. "p 0 y 31: expected 1 to be 10", stacked islands' lower run stone; the three real columns: scan.skyRun undefined), islandMask.test.ts 1 (the `enabled` doc), presetTrees.test.ts 1 (a function `by` is stored: "surface.rules.root.rules[1] NOT_JSON"). GREEN: typecheck OK; npm test 199 files passed | 2 skipped, 2866 passed | 1 expected fail | 9 skipped (Checkpoint M: 2863; +3), wall 124.7 s at load 0.6 → 8.8 (this run only; no other agent). Size: 11 files, +246 / −106.

```diff
+  let calls = 0;
+  const b = new Bench({ ...options });
+  b.add('busy', () => {
+    calls++;
+    const t = performance.now();
+    while (performance.now() - t < 0.8) { /* busy */ }
+  });
+  await b.run();
+  return calls;
+}
+
+test('terrain.islands run options (SP3e §7): exactly one warm-up call, so its 258 calls never pass the 512 precomputed columns', async () => {
+  expect(ISLANDS_RUN).toEqual({ iterations: 256, time: 0, warmupIterations: 1, warmupTime: 0 });
+  expect(ISLANDS_COLUMNS).toBe(512);
+  // A column about 4 × faster than this machine's 3.5 ms: tinybench's probe call when the function is added (does it
+  // return a promise?), one warm-up call and the 256 timed ones.
+  const calls = await benchCalls(ISLANDS_RUN);
+  expect(calls).toBe(258);
+  expect(calls).toBeLessThanOrEqual(ISLANDS_COLUMNS);
+  // Without warmupTime, tinybench warms up for 250 ms: far more than one call (about 310 at 0.8 ms on a quiet machine,
+  // which took the row's index past its 512 columns).
+  expect(await benchCalls({ iterations: 256, time: 0, warmupIterations: 1 })).toBeGreaterThan(258 + 50);
+}, 30_000);
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Regenerate the governed files and assets**

`test/baselines.json` is recorded on your machine, not copied: its numbers are machine-specific. `npm run bench:record` rewrites every row and refuses to write when an absolute gate fails: column p50 ≤ 0.7 ms and p95 ≤ 1.2 ms, `terrain.real` p50 ≤ 4 ms, `slice.vertical128` p50 ≤ 300 ms, `slice.partWorst` p50 ≤ 250 ms, `session.commitMaxTree` p50 ≤ 4 ms, and this task's new gate, `terrain.islands` p50 ≤ `TERRAIN_P50_MAX_MS` (4 ms). Nothing else may load the CPU (SP3a spec §7): check `uptime` (and `top -bn1 | head -15`) before each run and wait for a quiet machine; if the load stays high because of other programs, say so instead of recording. No generation code changes after Task 19, so this baseline is final. In this order:

1. `npm run bench` (pre-record, against SP3d's baseline). Every existing row must pass its +30 % gate, `terrain.real` included (and ≤ 4 ms p50), and every absolute gate must hold. `terrain.islands` has no baseline yet and is checked only against its absolute gate.
2. `npm run bench:record`.
3. `npm run bench`: every row within +30 % of the new baseline, and every absolute gate holds.

Then check that `git diff test/baselines.json` adds the `terrain.islands` row after `session.commitMaxTree` (27 entries, the calibration kernel included) and re-records every other row.

**The slice rows are bimodal** on the reference machine (a hybrid CPU): across whole bench runs `slice.horizontal128` is ≈ 500 or ≈ 600 ms and `slice.partWorst` ≈ 64 or ≈ 75 ms, the other rows unaffected. A record taken in the slow mode would loosen those rows' +30 % gate by about 20 % although SP3e does not touch them, so if your record's slice rows are more than ×1.1 SP3d's baseline while the pre-record run had them near it, run `npm run bench:record` once more and keep the fast-mode record (the dry run did: its first record had 598.9 / 75.4 ms, the committed one 501.4 / 64.4 ms).

**Amplified** (spec §7, no row): run `terrain.real`'s closure on `resolveProfile('amplified')` once with a throwaway bench, never committed. Save this as `test/bench/t20-amplified.bench.ts`, run `npx vitest bench --run --reporter=verbose --project "bench (bench)" test/bench/t20-amplified.bench.ts` three times on a quiet machine, record the median p50 of both rows, then delete the file:

```ts
// Throwaway (SP3e §7 "Amplified", Task 20): terrain.real's closure on the amplified params, 256 timed iterations after
// one warm-up on the terrain.real candidate sequence; DEFAULTS run the same way for reference. Copied into test/bench/
// for one run, then deleted; never committed.
import { test } from 'vitest';
import { resolveProfile } from '../../src/core/params/profiles';
import { DEFAULTS } from '../../src/core/params/defaults';
import { seedFromInput } from '../../src/core/seed';
import { createGenContext } from '../../src/gen/context';
import { fillColumnT } from '../../src/metrics/region';
import { createStore } from '../../src/world/store/store';
import type { Params } from '../../src/core/params/schema';

test('t20 amplified terrain.real', async ({ bench }) => {
  let sink = 0;
  const never = (): boolean => false;
  const run = async (name: string, params: Params) => {
    const gen = createGenContext(seedFromInput('42'), params);
    const store = createStore({ shared: true, maxBlockBytes: 32 << 20, maxByteBytes: 16 << 20 });
    let tc = 0;
    const r = await bench(name, () => {
      tc++;
      const tcx = (tc * 7919) % 60000 - 30000;
      const tcz = (tc * 104729) % 60000 - 30000;
      sink += fillColumnT(store, gen, tcx, tcz, never) ? 1 : 0;
      store.freeColumn(tcx, tcz);
    }).run({ iterations: 256, time: 0, warmupIterations: 1 });
    console.log(`T20 ${name} p50 ${r.latency.p50.toFixed(3)} ms, p99 ${r.latency.p99.toFixed(3)} ms (${tc} columns)`);
  };
  await run('terrain.real.amplified', resolveProfile('amplified'));
  await run('terrain.real.default256', DEFAULTS);
  if (!Number.isFinite(sink)) throw new Error('sink');
```

Create `test/unit/goldens.sp3e.test.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * The SP3e goldens (SP3e spec §6, D14): five keys chained last into `allGoldenKeys`, the frozen preset windows (the
 * search re-run on the approved values still finds them), what the windows show (the floating window holds an island
 * run over water, archipelago's holds sea and land, amplified's review line climbs above y 250), and the observer
 * that records the keys through `expectGolden`.
 */
import { describe, expect, test } from 'vitest';
import { ISLAND_RUN_MIN_BOTTOM } from '../../src/core/constants';
import { hex64 } from '../../src/core/hash';
import { resolveProfile } from '../../src/core/params/profiles';
import { seedFromInput } from '../../src/core/seed';
import { createGenContext } from '../../src/gen/context';
import { pointDigest } from '../../src/metrics/pointDigest';
import { genRegionInProcess, regionHash } from '../../src/metrics/region';
import { allGoldenKeys, computeAnyGolden } from '../../src/metrics/sp2aGoldens';
import {
  computeSp3eGolden, presetWindow, sp3eGoldenKeys, sp3eRegionDigest, sp3eWindow, WINDOW_PRESETS, type Sp3ePreset,
} from '../../src/metrics/sp3eGoldens';
import { fluidType } from '../../src/world/blocks/fluid';
import { COLLIDE } from '../../src/world/blocks/index';
import type { ColumnView } from '../../src/world/store/api';
import { createStore, type VoxelStore } from '../../src/world/store/store';
import { expectGolden } from '../harness/goldens';
import { presetReviewSite } from '../harness/reviewSlices';

const ctxOf = (p: Sp3ePreset) => createGenContext(seedFromInput('42'), resolveProfile(p));
const newStore = (shared: boolean): VoxelStore => createStore({ shared, maxBlockBytes: 32 << 20, maxByteBytes: 16 << 20 });

/** The preset's frozen 8 × 8 window generated in process on a store (`shared` as the caller asks). */
function windowStore(p: Sp3ePreset, shared: boolean): VoxelStore {
  const w = sp3eWindow(p);
  const store = newStore(shared);
  genRegionInProcess(store, ctxOf(p), w.chunkX, w.chunkZ, 8, 8);
  return store;
}

/** Every column view of the preset's window in `store`. */
function windowViews(p: Sp3ePreset, store: VoxelStore): ColumnView[] {
  const w = sp3eWindow(p);
  const out: ColumnView[] = [];
  for (let cz = w.chunkZ; cz < w.chunkZ + 8; cz++) {
    for (let cx = w.chunkX; cx < w.chunkX + 8; cx++) out.push(store.proto(cx, cz)!);
  }
  return out;
}

test('5 unique SP3e keys, in the spec\'s order, chained last into allGoldenKeys: 59 goldens', () => {
  const keys = sp3eGoldenKeys();
  expect(keys).toEqual([
    'sp3e.region.T.amplified', 'sp3e.region.T.archipelago', 'sp3e.region.T.floating_islands',
    'sp3e.column.point.archipelago', 'sp3e.column.point.floating_islands',
  ]);
  expect(allGoldenKeys().slice(-5)).toEqual(keys);
  expect(allGoldenKeys().slice(-7, -5)).toEqual(['sp3c.registry', 'sp3c.surface.ops']);
  expect(allGoldenKeys()).toHaveLength(59);
  expect(new Set(allGoldenKeys()).size).toBe(59);
});

test('unknown SP3e keys throw, directly and through computeAnyGolden', () => {
  for (const bad of [
    'sp3e.region.T.default', 'sp3e.column.point.amplified', 'sp3e.column.point.default', 'sp3e.region.T.large_biomes',
    'sp3e.region.T', 'sp3e.region.T.toString', 'sp3e.column.point', 'sp3e.region.D.amplified', 'sp3e.nope',
  ]) {
    expect(() => computeSp3eGolden(bad)).toThrow(/unknown golden/);
    expect(() => computeAnyGolden(bad)).toThrow(/unknown golden/);
  }
});

test('computeAnyGolden routes sp3e.* to computeSp3eGolden', () => {
  expect(computeAnyGolden('sp3e.region.T.amplified')).toBe(sp3eRegionDigest('amplified'));
});

describe('the frozen windows (seed 42, the approved values)', () => {
  test('literal: archipelago w(1, −1), amplified w(−5, 0), floating_islands w(−6, −11), with chunk origins and centres', () => {
    expect(sp3eWindow('archipelago')).toEqual({ a: 1, b: -1, chunkX: 4, chunkZ: -12, centreX: 128, centreZ: -128 });
    expect(sp3eWindow('amplified')).toEqual({ a: -5, b: 0, chunkX: -44, chunkZ: -4, centreX: -640, centreZ: 0 });
    expect(sp3eWindow('floating_islands')).toEqual({ a: -6, b: -11, chunkX: -52, chunkZ: -92, centreX: -768, centreZ: -1408 });
  });

  test.each(WINDOW_PRESETS)('%s: the window search re-run equals the committed window', (p) => {
    expect(presetWindow(p)).toEqual(sp3eWindow(p));
  });

  test('another profile has no window', () => {
    for (const bad of ['default', 'large_biomes', 'cave_heavy', 'toString']) {
      expect(() => sp3eWindow(bad as Sp3ePreset)).toThrow(RangeError);
    }
  });
});

describe('what the windows show', () => {
  test('floating_islands: the window holds island runs (bottom ≥ ISLAND_RUN_MIN_BOTTOM) with water below them', () => {
    const store = windowStore('floating_islands', true);
    // The region digest does not depend on the store kind.
    const w = sp3eWindow('floating_islands');
    expect(hex64(regionHash(store, w.chunkX, w.chunkZ, 8, 8))).toBe(sp3eRegionDigest('floating_islands'));
    let islandOverWater = 0;
    for (const v of windowViews('floating_islands', store)) {
      for (let lz = 0; lz < 16; lz++) {
        for (let lx = 0; lx < 16; lx++) {
          let y = 319;
          while (y >= -64 && COLLIDE[v.block(lx, y, lz)] === 0) y--;
          if (y < -64) continue;
          while (y > -64 && COLLIDE[v.block(lx, y - 1, lz)] !== 0) y--;
          // y is the bottom voxel of the position's highest solid run.
          if (y < ISLAND_RUN_MIN_BOTTOM) continue;
          for (let yy = y - 1; yy >= -64; yy--) {
            if (fluidType(v.fluid(lx, yy, lz)) !== 0) { islandOverWater++; break; }
          }
        }
      }
    }
    expect(islandOverWater).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  }, 60_000);

  test('archipelago: the window holds sea and land positions', () => {
    const store = windowStore('archipelago', false);
    let sea = 0;
    let land = 0;
    for (const v of windowViews('archipelago', store)) {
      const a = v.aux()!;
      for (let p = 0; p < 256; p++) {
        if (a.worldSurfaceWG[p]! > a.oceanFloorWG[p]!) sea++;
        else land++;
      }
    }
    expect(sea).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(land).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  }, 60_000);

  test('amplified: the highest land top on its review line (Task 14\'s site at the window centre) is ≥ 250', () => {
    const w = sp3eWindow('amplified');
    const site = presetReviewSite('amplified', { x: w.centreX, z: w.centreZ });
    const ctx = ctxOf('amplified');
    const store = newStore(false);
    const cz = site.z >> 4;
    const lz = site.z & 15;
    let maxLandTop = -Infinity;
    for (let cx = site.cx0; cx < site.cx0 + site.w; cx++) {
      genRegionInProcess(store, ctx, cx, cz, 1, 1);
      const a = store.proto(cx, cz)!.aux()!;
      for (let lx = 0; lx < 16; lx++) {
        const p = lz * 16 + lx;
        if (a.worldSurfaceWG[p] === a.oceanFloorWG[p]) maxLandTop = Math.max(maxLandTop, a.oceanFloorWG[p]! - 1);
      }
      store.freeColumn(cx, cz);
    }
    expect(maxLandTop).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(250);
  }, 60_000);
});

test('the column-point keys are pointDigest on the preset (moved unchanged from sp2aGoldens.ts)', () => {
  expect(computeSp3eGolden('sp3e.column.point.archipelago')).toBe(pointDigest('archipelago'));
});

describe('SP3e goldens', () => {
  test.each(sp3eGoldenKeys())('%s', (key) => {
    expectGolden(key, computeSp3eGolden(key));
  }, 60_000);
});
```

````diff
 - **Exit:** Z1-Z4; cave_heavy C1 10-22 %; every other active metric green per preset; DT1 goldens stable; no open cut-line items (unless explicitly dropped by the user with the D-decision impact recorded).
````

Create `src/metrics/pointDigest.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * The column-point digest (SP2a spec §7.4), moved unchanged from `sp2aGoldens.ts` (SP3e spec §6): `sp2a.column.point.*`
 * and `sp3e.column.point.*` both hash it, and `sp2aGoldens.ts` imports `sp3eGoldens.ts` for the golden chain, so the
 * digest lives in its own module to keep the imports acyclic. Follows the core determinism rules (in `DET_FILES`,
 * arch-tested). Every value is hex64.
 */
import { fnv1a32, hashF64, hex64 } from '../core/hash';
import { resolveProfile, type ProfileId } from '../core/params/profiles';
import { Xoshiro128 } from '../core/rng';
import { seedFromInput } from '../core/seed';
import { createGenContext } from '../gen/context';
import { columnPoint, type ColumnPoint } from '../gen/column/columnPoint';

const FNV32 = fnv1a32;
const HASH_F64 = hashF64;
const HEX64 = hex64;
const RESOLVE = resolveProfile;
const Rng = Xoshiro128;
const SEED = seedFromInput;
const CREATE = createGenContext;
const POINT = columnPoint;

const N_POINTS = 4096;

/** Every ColumnPoint field in a fixed order (booleans as 0/1). */
export function pointValues(p: ColumnPoint, out: Float64Array, o: number): void {
  const v = [p.C, p.E, p.W, p.T, p.H, p.R, p.PV, p.offset0, p.sigma0, p.jag0, p.steep, p.riverDist, p.riverStrength, p.riverWet ? 1 : 0, p.gorge ? 1 : 0,
    p.lakeMask, p.lakeLevel, p.lakeFloor, p.offset, p.sigma, p.jag, p.surfaceWaterLevel, p.surfaceEst, p.islandMask, p.biome];
  for (let k = 0; k < 25; k++) out[o + k] = v[k]!;
}

/** columnPoint at 4096 points from Xoshiro128(fnv1a32('sp2a.point')) in the colKey window, world seed '42'. */
export function pointDigest(profile: ProfileId): string {
  const ctx = CREATE(SEED('42'), RESOLVE(profile));
  const r = new Rng(FNV32('sp2a.point'));
  const out = new Float64Array(N_POINTS * 25);
  for (let i = 0; i < N_POINTS; i++) {
    const x = -524288 + 1048576 * r.nextFloat();
    const z = -524288 + 1048576 * r.nextFloat();
    pointValues(POINT(ctx, x, z), out, 25 * i);
  }
  return HEX64(HASH_F64(out));
}
```

```diff
+export function sp3eGoldenKeys(): string[] {

+export function computeSp3eGolden(key: string): string {
+  const region = /^sp3e\.region\.T\.(.+)$/.exec(key);
```

```diff
+/** The SP3e assets directory (spec §8): one directory per draft preset, and the tuning sets (§1.5). */
+const SP3E_ASSETS = new URL('../../docs/superpowers/specs/assets/sp3e/', import.meta.url);
+const WRITING = process.env.REVIEW_SLICES_DIR !== undefined;
+
+/** A preset's review site at its committed window centre (`sp3eGoldens.ts`, frozen by the goldens). */
+const presetSite = (p: DraftPresetId): VerticalSite => {
+  const w = sp3eWindow(p);
+  return presetReviewSite(p, { x: w.centreX, z: w.centreZ });
+};
+
+/**
+ * The bottom voxel of the highest solid run of position (x, z) when it is an island run (bottom ≥ ISLAND_RUN_MIN_BOTTOM)
+ * with water below it and solid ground below that water; else null.
+ */
+function islandOverWaterOverGround(view: RegionView, x: number, z: number): number | null {
+  let y = 319;
+  while (y >= -64 && view.block(x, y, z) === AIR) y--;
+  if (y < -64) return null;
+  while (y > -64 && view.block(x, y - 1, z) !== AIR) y--;
+  if (y < ISLAND_RUN_MIN_BOTTOM) return null;
+  let yy = y - 1;
+  while (yy >= -64 && !(view.block(x, yy, z) === AIR && fluidType(view.fluid(x, yy, z)) !== 0)) yy--;
+  if (yy < -64) return null;
+  while (yy >= -64 && view.block(x, yy, z) === AIR) yy--;
+  return yy >= -64 ? y : null;
+}
+

+  const summaryOf = (p: DraftPresetId): LineSummary => {
+    const site = presetSite(p);
+    const { z, x0, n } = siteLine(site);
+    const view = lines.get(p)!;
+    return lineSummary(view, z, x0, n, kindReader(createGenContext(seedFromInput('42'), resolveProfile(p)), view, z));

+  test('the lines through the committed centres: archipelago (128, −128), amplified (−640, 0), floating_islands (−768, −1408)', () => {
```

```diff
+/** A slice with `fill(i, y)` → [state, water] per sample i and y (air and no fluid where it returns null). */
+function slice(fill: (i: number, y: number) => readonly [number, boolean] | null): { blocks: Uint16Array<ArrayBuffer>; fluid: Uint8Array<ArrayBuffer> } {
+  const blocks = new Uint16Array(SLICE_SAMPLES);
+  const fluid = new Uint8Array(SLICE_SAMPLES);
+  for (let i = 0; i < 512; i++) {
+    for (let y = -64; y <= 319; y++) {
+      const v = fill(i, y);
+      if (v === null) continue;
+      blocks[sliceIndex(i, y)] = v[0];
+      if (v[1]) fluid[sliceIndex(i, y)] = WATER_SOURCE;
+    }
+  }
+  return { blocks, fluid };
+}
+
+/** Ground (stone, bedrock at −64) up to `ground`, water above it to 63 when `ground` < 63, and an island run [lo, hi] (grass-topped). */
+const islandColumn = (ground: number, island: readonly [number, number] | null) => (_i: number, y: number): readonly [number, boolean] | null => {
+  if (y === -64) return [BEDROCK, false];
+  if (y <= ground) return [STONE, false];
+  if (island !== null && y >= island[0] && y <= island[1]) return [y === island[1] ? GRASS_BLOCK : STONE, false];
+  if (y <= 63) return [AIR, true];
+  return null;
+};
```

```diff
+/** The Voxels slice image (512 × 384 RGBA, row-major) as the page draws it. */
+function voxelImage(p: Page): Promise<number[]> {
+  return p.eval<number[]>(`Array.from(document.querySelector('.cs-voxels').getContext('2d').getImageData(0, 0, 512, 384).data)`);
+}
+
+/** The sample nearest the line's middle whose column holds an island over ground (`islandOverGround`), or null. */
+function islandSample(image: ArrayLike<number>): { readonly i: number; readonly islandTop: number; readonly islandBottom: number; readonly groundRow: number } | null {
+  const order = [...Array(512).keys()].sort((x, y) => Math.abs(x - 256) - Math.abs(y - 256) || x - y);
+  for (const i of order) {
+    const hit = islandOverGround(sliceColumn(image, i));
+    if (hit !== null) return { i, ...hit };
+  }
+  return null;
+}
+
+/** The sample whose ground top is highest (the first such from A), with its row, or null on an all-air slice. */
+function highestSample(image: ArrayLike<number>): { readonly i: number; readonly row: number } | null {
+  let best: { i: number; row: number } | null = null;
+  for (let i = 0; i < 512; i++) {
+    const row = groundTopRow(sliceColumn(image, i));
+    if (row !== null && (best === null || row < best.row)) best = { i, row };
+  }
+  return best;
+}
+
+/** The pointer on the cell (sample i, image row `row`) of the Voxels slice; resolves with the readout once it names a rule (or after 10 s). */
+async function hoverVoxel(p: Page, i: number, row: number): Promise<string> {
+  await p.mouse('mouseMoved', ...sliceCellPoint((await p.center('.cs-voxels')).box, i, row));
+  await p.until(`/ · rule (?:root\\S*|none)$/.test(document.querySelector('.cs-readout').textContent)`, 'the hover rule id', 10000).catch(() => undefined);
+  return p.eval<string>(`document.querySelector('.cs-readout').textContent`);
+}
+
+/** The map canvas's pixels in the PRESET_MAP.px² square centred on the canvas centre (the view centre), RGBA row-major. */
+async function presetMapPixels(p: Page): Promise<{ readonly rgba: number[]; readonly clip: Box }> {
+  const mc = await p.center('.map-canvas');
+  const half = PRESET_MAP.px / 2;
+  const w = await p.eval<{ rgba: number[]; width: number; cx: number; cy: number }>(`__wiSmoke.mapPixels(${mc.x}, ${mc.y}, ${half})`);
+  // mapPixels reads the (2·half + 1)² window around the centre; keep its first PRESET_MAP.px rows and columns.
+  const rgba: number[] = [];
+  for (let y = 0; y < PRESET_MAP.px; y++) rgba.push(...w.rgba.slice(4 * y * w.width, 4 * (y * w.width + PRESET_MAP.px)));
+  return { rgba, clip: { x: Math.round(mc.x) - half, y: Math.round(mc.y) - half, width: PRESET_MAP.px, height: PRESET_MAP.px } };
+}
+
+/**
+ * Opens `preset` on its window centre at PRESET_MAP's scale on `layer`, settled, and waits until the map square reads
+ * the same twice 500 ms apart (the fine tiles replace the upscaled previews after the first preview lands); resolves
+ * with that square.
+ */
+async function openPresetMap(p: Page, preset: SmokePreset, layer: string): Promise<{ readonly rgba: number[]; readonly clip: Box }> {
+  const [x, z] = presetCentre(preset);
+  await p.goto(`${p.base}?map#${mapHash(presetState(preset, { x, z, bpp: PRESET_MAP.bpp, layer }))}`, MAP_READY);
+  let last = await presetMapPixels(p);
+  for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
+    await sleep(500);
+    await p.until('__wiSmoke.settled()', `the ${layer} map of ${preset}`);
+    const now = await presetMapPixels(p);
+    if (sameJson(now.rgba, last.rgba)) return now;
+    last = now;
+  }
+  throw new Error(`the ${layer} map of ${preset} kept changing for 15 s`);
+}
+
+/**
+ * The `preset profiles` step (SP3e spec §8): each draft preset opened by URL with its profile on its line — the select
+ * shows it among the five ready profiles, the World tab and the URL name it, the Voxels summary holds what the preset
+ * promises (`presetSummaryOk`), and no page error; floating_islands' line holds an island over ground whose top voxel
+ * takes a surface rule (D21 (b)) and its `islandMask` layer draws ≥ 2 colours; archipelago's `biome` layer around its
+ * window holds ocean and land.
+ */
+async function runPresetProfiles(t: Smoke): Promise<void> {
+  const p = t.page;
+  t.step('preset profiles: each draft preset opened by URL on its window line, its map layer around the window');
+  for (const preset of SMOKE_PRESETS) {
+    const errors0 = t.errors.length;
+    const line = presetLine(preset);
+    const state = presetState(preset, line.view);
+    const { text, summary } = await openLineVoxels(p, state, line, `${preset}'s line`);
+    const select = await p.eval<{ value: string; options: string[] }>(`(() => { const s = document.querySelector('.map-toolbar select[title="Profile"]'); return { value: s.value, options: [...s.options].filter((o) => !o.disabled).map((o) => o.value) }; })()`);
+    t.check(select.value === preset && sameJson(select.options, READY_PROFILES), `${preset}: the profile select shows it among ${select.options.join(', ')}`, select);
+    const url = await p.state();
+    t.check(url !== null && url.profile === preset && sameJson(url.patch, {}), `${preset}: the URL holds the profile, nothing modified`, url);
+    t.check((await p.eval<string>('__wiSmoke.world()')).includes(`profile ${preset}\n`), `${preset}: the World tab shows the profile`);
+    t.check(presetSummaryOk(preset, summary), `${preset} on ${text}: ${summary}`, summary);
+    if (preset === 'floating_islands') {
+      const island = islandSample(await voxelImage(p));
+      t.check(island !== null, `an island over ground on the line: ${island === null ? 'none' : `sample ${island.i}, island y ${island.islandBottom}-${island.islandTop}, ground top y ${319 - island.groundRow}`}`);
+      if (island !== null) {
+        const read = await hoverVoxel(p, island.i, island.groundRow);
+        const id = voxelRuleId(read);
+        t.check(voxelReadoutOk(read) && read.includes(`, ${319 - island.groundRow}, `) && id !== null, `the ground under the island takes a surface rule (D21 (b)): ${read}`, read);
+        await p.mouse('mouseMoved', 5, 5);
+      }
+      const n = distinctColours((await openPresetMap(p, preset, 'islandMask')).rgba);
+      t.check(n >= 2, `floating_islands' islandMask layer around the window (4096² blocks, 16 blocks/px) draws ${n} colours (≥ 16 px each)`, n);
+    } else if (preset === 'archipelago') {
+      const counts = biomePixels((await openPresetMap(p, preset, 'biome')).rgba);
+      t.check(oceanAndLandOk(counts), `archipelago's biome layer around the window (4096² blocks): ocean ${counts.ocean}, land ${counts.land}, other ${counts.other} px`, counts);
+    }
+    t.check(t.errors.length === errors0, `${preset}: no page error`, t.errors.slice(errors0));
+  }
+}
```

```diff
+function nodeAt(tree: unknown, path: string): unknown {
+  let x = tree;
+  for (const k of path.split('.')) {
+    expect(x !== null && typeof x === 'object' && Object.hasOwn(x, k), `no ${k} in ${path}`).toBe(true);
+    x = (x as Record<string, unknown>)[k];
+  }
+  return x;
+}

+  return text.slice(from, text.indexOf('### Critical path', from));
+}
+
+/** A §3.15 table row of a preset. */

+  const from = text.indexOf('### 3.15 Extreme presets');
+  const to = text.indexOf('### 3.16', from);
+  const row = text.slice(from, to).split('\n').find((l) => l.startsWith(`| ${id} |`));
+  expect(row, `no ${id} row in §3.15`).toBeDefined();
+  return row!;
+}
```

````diff
 SP3c gives the terrain its biome surfaces. A data-driven surface-rule tree, compiled to closures and checked against a reference evaluator, runs a whole-column scan inside the terrain stage and turns the stone into 22 new block types: grass and dirt with podzol, coarse dirt and mud patches, sand and sandstone, gravel, clay under water, snow above the altitude-dependent snowline, packed ice and stone cliffs, calcite, the badlands' red sand over wavering terracotta bands, dithered bedrock, and deepslate below the skin. Its tunables are the `surface.*` parameters below; the Voxels mode colours every block and its hover readout names the rule that placed the voxel (for example `rule root.rules[1].then.rules[3].then.rules[6].then.rules[7]` for a grass top). Untrusted trees from the URL, a preset or the editor pass two validation tiers (JSON bounds, then op shapes, references, depth, cost and value-range checks) or are refused with the path of each issue.
````
